dataset: Symptom cards (sym.*) — the fourth diagnostic namespace (D11)
policy: Pilot 0 is a STRESS TEST of Batch A, not the start of a symptom database. Three cards were chosen because each loads a different part of the design: headache exercises location/quality/laterality and the red-flag layer, edema exercises the two observation modes, fever exercises the boundary between a symptom and a measurement.
Records are born when someone fills them from a real source (D14). The 129 CloudTCM candidates are a gap map, not content, and are NOT imported here.
Ids are permanent (D1). A card is retired with review_status deprecated, never deleted (D6).

supporting_measurements is DELIBERATELY ABSENT from sym.edema and sym.fever. The measurements they need (body weight, body temperature) do not exist in data/clinical_cases/outcome_metrics.json, and that file is the vocabulary for visit_outcomes — outcome tracking over time, not a vital-sign register. Inventing metric.body_temperature there would put a vital sign into an outcome-tracking list because that was the only list available. Reported to Ting instead; see PROJECT_LOG 2026-08-06.

Batch B (2026-08-12, docs/SPRINT_2026-08-12_BRIEF.md) adds 15 pilot cards on top of Pilot 0's three (headache, edema, fever). Selection follows the sprint brief's priority list intersected with what is actually staged in data/research_staging/sym_seed_research_batch_b_v1.json (CR-001): insomnia, fatigue, low_back_pain, neck_pain, shoulder_pain, dizziness, vertigo, tinnitus, palpitations, nausea, abdominal_bloating, constipation, diarrhea, poor_appetite, weakness. night_sweats/anxiety-irritability-class/cold-limbs-class from the brief's suggestion were NOT staged in CR-001 and are left for a future batch rather than invented here.

Batch C (2026-08-12/13) adds the remaining staged sym.* candidates on top of Batch B's 15 + Pilot 0's 3. Source: data/research_staging/sym_seed_research_batch_b_v1.json (CR-001, 12 records not yet built: knee_pain, shortness_of_breath, cough, abdominal_pain, reflux, hot_flash, dysmenorrhea, heavy_menstrual_bleeding, nasal_congestion, pruritus, muscle_cramp, numbness) and data/research_staging/sym_extension_batch_d_v1.json (CR-008, 19 of 20 records — sym.edema was already canonical from Pilot 0 and is skipped as a duplicate: epigastric_pain, belching, hiccup, vomiting, regurgitation, early_satiety, tenesmus, urinary_urgency, urinary_retention, hematuria, vaginal_discharge, intermenstrual_bleeding, breast_tenderness, blurred_vision, dry_eyes, tremor, poor_concentration, limb_heaviness, spontaneous_bruising). 31 records built, 1 skipped as duplicate (edema). Two staged compound name_zh values were split rather than carried verbatim: CR-008's "反酸 / 反流" became canonical name_zh 反酸 with 反流 as an alias, and "癃閉 / 尿瀦留" became canonical name_zh 尿瀦留 with 癃閉 as an alias — a slash is not a valid single term for a controlled name_zh field. sym.reflux (胃食道逆流症狀, the retrosternal burning/heartburn observation) and sym.regurgitation (反酸, the fact of material rising into the throat/mouth) are kept as two distinct cards rather than merged: they are two different observation points on the same GERD mechanism, matching how GI history-taking distinguishes heartburn from regurgitation. All tradition: both per docs/SYMPTOM_CARD_TEMPLATE.md §1.

records.definition_zh: 頭部的疼痛，範圍含前額、兩側、巔頂、後枕與眼眶周圍。它是主訴，不是診斷 —— 同一個「頭痛」可以出現在數十個西醫病名與中醫病名之下，所以卡片記錄的是「該問什麼、指向哪裡」，不是結論。
records.definition_en: Pain in the head, spanning the forehead, temples, vertex, occiput and the region around the orbits. It is a presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same headache appears under dozens of biomedical and TCM disease names, so this card records what to ask and what it points toward, not a conclusion.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一跳一跳的」「像被箍住、綁一條帶子」「頭很重，像戴著帽子」「痛到想吐、怕光」「只有一邊痛」「後腦勺緊緊的」「整個頭都是脹的」
records.patient_words_en: "Throbbing", "like a band tightened around my head", "heavy, as if I'm wearing a hat", "bad enough to make me sick, and light hurts", "only one side", "tight at the back of my head", "my whole head feels full"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 脹屬氣滯或肝陽 · 刺屬血瘀 · 隱屬虛 · 重屬濕痰 · 空屬精血虧虛 · 跳屬肝陽或血分

inquiry_zh.why: 前額屬陽明 · 兩側屬少陽 · 巔頂屬厥陰 · 後枕屬太陽。部位直接決定循經取穴
脹痛、刺痛、隱痛、頭重如裹分屬四類病機，是本症最有辨證重量的一問
晨起、午後、夜間加重各有指向；經前發作提示衝任與肝
情緒、月經、勞累、風寒、睡眠不足、飲酒與特定食物
按之減輕屬虛、拒按屬實、得溫則減屬寒、靜臥暗室緩解提示偏頭痛
噁心畏光畏聲提示偏頭痛；發熱頸僵、神經缺損、意識改變則進入紅旗流程
新發劇烈與長期反覆的處置完全不同 —— 這一問決定要不要先轉診

inquiry_en.why: Forehead = Yangming, temples = Shaoyang, vertex = Jueyin, occiput = Taiyang. Location drives channel-based point selection
Distending, stabbing, dull and heavy-as-if-wrapped map to four different mechanisms — the highest-yield question on this symptom
Worse on waking, in the afternoon or at night each point somewhere; premenstrual onset implicates the Chong/Ren and the Liver
Emotion, menses, exertion, wind-cold, poor sleep, alcohol and specific foods
Better for pressure = deficiency, worse for pressure = excess, better for warmth = cold; relief in a dark quiet room suggests migraine
Nausea, photophobia and phonophobia suggest migraine; fever with neck stiffness, focal deficit or altered consciousness enter the red-flag pathway
A new severe headache and a long-standing recurrent one are handled completely differently — this question decides whether to refer first

differentiation_zh.variant: 脹痛
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 頭目脹痛，多在兩側或巔頂，情緒波動或熬夜後加重，兼面紅目赤、急躁易怒、腰膝痠軟

differentiation_zh.variant: 刺痛
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 痛處固定不移、拒按，夜間痛甚，多有головache 久病或外傷史，唇舌紫暗

differentiation_zh.variant: 隱痛綿綿
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 痛勢綿綿，勞累後加重，按之稍舒，兼神疲乏力、面色淡白或萎黃、心悸

differentiation_zh.variant: 頭重如裹
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 頭昏沉重如布包裹，胸悶脘痞、身重困倦、痰多，陰雨天加重

differentiation_zh.variant: 頭痛連項背，惡風寒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 起病急，痛連項背，遇風加重，喜裹頭，多見於外感初起

differentiation_zh.variant: 頭空痛
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 頭腦空痛，兼耳鳴、健忘、腰膝痠軟、齒搖髮脫，多見於久病或年長者

differentiation_en.variant: Distending pain
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Distending pain in head and eyes, usually temporal or at the vertex, worse with emotional swings or late nights, with red face and eyes, irritability and weak aching low back and knees

differentiation_en.variant: Stabbing pain
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fixed, unmoving, worse for pressure and worse at night, often long-standing or post-traumatic, with dusky lips and tongue

differentiation_en.variant: Dull lingering pain
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vague and continuous, worse after exertion, slightly better for pressure, with fatigue, pale or sallow complexion and palpitations

differentiation_en.variant: Heavy head, as if wrapped
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Muzzy heaviness as though the head were bound in cloth, with chest and epigastric fullness, heavy tired limbs, copious phlegm, worse in damp weather

differentiation_en.variant: Pain extending to nape and back with aversion to wind-cold
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Abrupt onset, pain running into the nape and upper back, worse in a draught, the patient wants the head covered; typical of early external contraction

differentiation_en.variant: Empty pain
differentiation_en.distinguishing: A hollow ache inside the head with tinnitus, forgetfulness, weak aching low back and knees, loosening teeth and hair loss; usually chronic illness or older patients

safety_review_sources: ICHD-3 — International Classification of Headache Disorders, 3rd edition
SNNOOP10 headache red-flag list (Do TP et al., Neurology 2019)
red_flags_zh: 霹靂性頭痛：數秒內達到最劇烈 → 立即排除蛛網膜下腔出血
發熱合併頸項僵硬、畏光 → 排除腦膜炎／腦炎
新發神經功能缺損、意識或人格改變、癲癇發作 → 需影像評估
50 歲後新發頭痛，或原有型態明顯改變、進行性加重 → 排除顱內病變、巨細胞動脈炎
咳嗽、用力、彎腰或平躺時加重 → 排除顱內壓異常
免疫低下、癌症病史、抗凝或抗血小板治療中新發頭痛 → 轉診評估
red_flags_en: Thunderclap headache reaching maximum intensity within seconds → rule out subarachnoid haemorrhage immediately
Fever with neck stiffness and photophobia → rule out meningitis/encephalitis
New focal neurological deficit, altered consciousness or personality, or seizure → imaging required
New headache after age 50, or a marked change in an established pattern with progressive worsening → rule out intracranial lesion and giant cell arteritis
Worse with cough, straining, bending or lying flat → rule out abnormal intracranial pressure
New headache in someone immunosuppressed, with a cancer history, or on anticoagulant/antiplatelet therapy → refer for assessment
sources: ICHD-3 — International Classification of Headache Disorders, 3rd edition（分類與發作特徵）
SNNOOP10 headache red-flag list (Do TP et al., Neurology 2019)（紅旗清單）
中醫內科學／中醫診斷學 通行教材內容 —— 頭痛的經絡分部（陽明／少陽／厥陰／太陽）與證型鑑別

field_sources.inquiry_zh/en 部位: 中醫內科學 頭痛的經絡分部（前額陽明・兩側少陽・巔頂厥陰・後枕太陽）

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: SNNOOP10 (Do TP et al., Neurology 2019) 與 ICHD-3 續發性頭痛警示準則

records.definition_zh: 水液瀦留泛溢肌膚，使眼瞼、頭面、四肢、腹背甚至全身浮腫。病人先察覺的是「穿不下、戴不上」，醫者確認的是按之凹陷與否、分布與對稱性 —— 這是本症同時具備自述與他覺兩種取得型態的原因。
records.definition_en: Retained fluid spilling into the tissues, puffing up the eyelids, face, limbs, abdomen and back, or the whole body. The patient notices it as things no longer fitting; the examiner confirms it by pressing for pitting and by reading the distribution and symmetry — which is why this symptom genuinely carries both observation modes.
records.patient_words_zh: 「鞋子突然穿不下」「早上起來眼皮腫腫的」「按下去有一個坑，很久才回來」「戒指拔不下來」「腳脹脹的，一整天下來更腫」「襪子的痕跡很深」
records.patient_words_en: "My shoes suddenly don't fit", "my eyelids are puffy when I wake up", "press it and there's a dent that takes ages to fill", "I can't get my ring off", "my feet feel tight, worse by the end of the day", "deep sock marks"

quality.why: symptom_quality 是疼痛性質詞彙（脹刺隱空灼重竄絞酸掣墜麻冷跳）。水腫最關鍵的性質是「凹陷性／非凹陷性」與「皮膚繃急光亮／鬆軟」，該詞彙表沒有這個軸，因此不宣稱適用（見 Pilot 0 回報）

inquiry_zh.why: 先腫眼瞼頭面多屬陽水、風水；先腫足踝而腰以下甚多屬陰水、脾腎陽虛
晨起眼瞼腫、午後與久站後下肢腫 —— 這一組時間差是分辨上下與虛實的關鍵
外感、飲食鹹膩、久站久坐、經前、藥物（鈣離子阻斷劑、類固醇、NSAID）
抬高患肢是否消退、臥床一夜是否減輕
尿量、尿泡沫、呼吸困難、體重變化、單側疼痛熱感 —— 紅旗都掛在這一問上
突發數日與長期漸進，鑑別方向完全不同

inquiry_en.why: Starting at the eyelids and face suggests yang edema / wind edema; starting at the ankles and worst below the waist suggests yin edema with Spleen and Kidney yang deficiency
Puffy eyelids on waking versus leg swelling in the afternoon and after long standing — this contrast is the key to upper/lower and deficiency/excess
External contraction, salty or rich food, prolonged standing or sitting, premenstrual phase, medication (calcium channel blockers, steroids, NSAIDs)
Whether elevation reduces it, and whether a night lying flat improves it
Urine volume, frothy urine, breathlessness, weight change, one-sided pain and warmth — every red flag hangs off this question
Days-old sudden swelling and slow chronic swelling point in completely different directions

differentiation_zh.variant: 腰以下腫甚，按之凹陷不易復
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 下肢腫甚，按之凹陷久不回復，畏寒肢冷、腰膝痠冷、夜尿頻多或大便清稀，屬陰水

differentiation_zh.variant: 晨起眼瞼微腫，食少便溏
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腫勢不甚而反覆，晨起眼瞼與面部為著，兼食少腹脹、便溏、倦怠乏力、面色萎黃

differentiation_zh.variant: 腫處皮膚繃急光亮，胸悶煩熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腫勢較急，皮膚繃急光亮，胸腹痞悶、煩熱口苦、小便短赤，屬陽水濕熱壅盛

differentiation_en.variant: Worst below the waist, pits deeply and refills slowly
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Legs most affected, pitting that is slow to refill, with cold aversion and cold limbs, cold aching low back and knees, frequent night urination or loose stool — yin edema

differentiation_en.variant: Slight puffy eyelids on waking, poor appetite and loose stool
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Mild but recurrent, most marked in the eyelids and face on waking, with poor appetite, abdominal fullness, loose stool, fatigue and a sallow complexion

differentiation_en.variant: Skin taut and shiny over the swelling, chest fullness and vexing heat
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Faster onset, skin stretched tight and glossy, fullness in chest and abdomen, vexing heat, bitter taste, scanty dark urine — yang edema with damp-heat

safety_review_sources: 常規內科學水腫鑑別診斷（心源性／腎源性／肝源性／靜脈與淋巴回流障礙／藥物性）
深層靜脈栓塞與子癇前症的通行臨床警示準則
red_flags_zh: 單側下肢腫脹合併疼痛、皮溫升高、壓痛 → 排除深層靜脈栓塞（可致肺栓塞）
突發呼吸困難、端坐呼吸、夜間陣發性呼吸困難 → 排除心衰竭／肺水腫
眼瞼顏面浮腫合併泡沫尿、尿量明顯減少 → 排除腎病症候群／急性腎炎
妊娠 20 週後水腫合併高血壓、頭痛、視覺異常 → 排除子癇前症
顏面、頸部與雙上肢腫脹合併頸靜脈怒張 → 排除上腔靜脈症候群
局部紅、腫、熱、痛合併發熱 → 排除蜂窩性組織炎
短期內體重快速增加合併腹脹膨隆 → 評估腹水與肝腎功能
red_flags_en: One-sided leg swelling with pain, warmth and tenderness → rule out deep vein thrombosis (risk of pulmonary embolism)
Sudden breathlessness, orthopnoea or paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea → rule out heart failure / pulmonary oedema
Facial and eyelid puffiness with frothy urine and markedly reduced output → rule out nephrotic syndrome / acute nephritis
Oedema after 20 weeks of pregnancy with hypertension, headache or visual disturbance → rule out pre-eclampsia
Swelling of face, neck and both arms with distended neck veins → rule out superior vena cava syndrome
Localised redness, swelling, heat and pain with fever → rule out cellulitis
Rapid weight gain over a short period with abdominal distension → assess for ascites and hepatic/renal function
sources: 常規內科學水腫鑑別診斷章節（心源性／腎源性／肝源性／靜脈淋巴回流障礙／藥物性）
中醫內科學 水腫篇 —— 陽水與陰水的分證（風水泛濫・濕熱壅盛・脾陽虛衰・腎陽衰微）
《金匱要略》水氣病脈證并治 —— 風水／皮水／正水／石水的古典分類

field_sources.inquiry_zh/en: 中醫內科學 水腫辨證要點（辨陽水陰水、辨腫勢部位先後）
field_sources.differentiation_zh/en: 中醫內科學 水腫分證 + 本 repo pattern_library 對應證型 key_signs_zh
field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: 內科學水腫鑑別診斷；DVT 與子癇前症通行臨床警示準則

records.definition_zh: 體溫升高，或病人自覺身熱。中醫的「發熱」比西醫的 fever 更寬：它同時涵蓋捫之烙手的實際體溫升高（壯熱、潮熱）與體溫未必升高的自覺熱感（五心煩熱、身熱不揚）——兩者辨證意義不同，不可混為一談。體溫的「數值」屬測量層，不在本卡。
records.definition_en: A raised body temperature, or the patient's own sense of being hot. The TCM concept is broader than biomedical fever: it covers both objectively hot skin (blazing heat, tidal heat) and a subjective sense of heat that may occur at a normal temperature (five-centre heat, unsurfaced heat). The two carry different diagnostic weight and must not be collapsed. The numeric temperature belongs to the measurement layer, not to this card.
records.patient_words_zh: 「燒起來了」「一陣冷一陣熱」「手心腳心發燙」「一到下午就開始熱」「熱但流不出汗」「身上悶熱，摸起來又不很燙」「晚上睡到一半熱醒、流汗」
records.patient_words_en: "I've come down with a temperature", "hot and cold in waves", "my palms and soles burn", "it starts every afternoon", "hot but I can't sweat", "I feel stifled and hot but don't feel that hot to the touch", "I wake up hot and sweating in the night"

location.why: 發熱為全身性，無病灶部位。惟「五心煩熱」的手足心與心胸是一種熱感分布，現有 symptom_taxonomy 是身體部位分類軸，承載不了這個維度（見 Pilot 0 回報）

quality.why: symptom_quality 是疼痛性質詞彙。發熱的性質軸是壯熱／潮熱／身熱不揚／五心煩熱／往來寒熱，屬熱型，不在該詞彙表中（見 Pilot 0 回報）

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 午後潮熱指向陰虛或濕熱 · 夜間發熱盜汗指向陰虛 · 勞累後發熱指向氣虛。時間是本症最有辨證重量的維度

inquiry_zh.why: 午後潮熱屬陰虛或濕熱、夜熱早涼屬熱入營血、勞則熱甚屬氣虛 —— 本症辨證最重的一問
壯熱、潮熱、身熱不揚、五心煩熱、往來寒熱是五種不同熱型
惡寒之有無與輕重定表裡；汗、渴、二便定寒熱虛實；頸僵、意識改變、瘀點進紅旗流程
外感、勞累、情志、飲食積滯、近期旅遊與接觸史、用藥（含免疫抑制）
驟起數日屬外感發熱；反覆或遷延屬內傷發熱，兩條路徑完全不同

inquiry_en.why: Afternoon tidal heat suggests yin deficiency or damp-heat; heat at night clearing by morning suggests heat in the nutritive and blood levels; heat worse with exertion suggests qi deficiency — the highest-yield question here
Blazing heat, tidal heat, unsurfaced heat, five-centre heat and alternating chills and fever are five distinct heat types

Presence and degree of chills separates exterior from interior; sweat, thirst and the two excretions separate cold/heat and deficiency/excess; neck stiffness, altered consciousness or petechiae enter the red-flag pathway
External contraction, exertion, emotion, food stagnation, recent travel and exposure history, medication including immunosuppressants
Abrupt onset over days is externally contracted fever; recurrent or lingering fever is internal-damage fever — two entirely different pathways

differentiation_zh.variant: 發熱惡寒並見，惡寒重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 起病急，惡寒重而發熱輕，無汗，頭身疼痛，鼻塞流清涕，脈浮緊

differentiation_zh.variant: 發熱重惡寒輕
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 發熱明顯而惡寒輕微，咽喉腫痛，口渴，咳痰黃稠，脈浮數

differentiation_zh.variant: 午後潮熱，五心煩熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 午後或入夜熱甚，手足心與心胸煩熱，盜汗、顴紅、口乾咽燥，多見於久病或熱病後期

differentiation_zh.variant: 身熱不揚，午後熱甚，頭身困重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 初捫不甚熱，久按灼手，午後轉甚，頭身困重、胸脘痞悶、口黏不渴或渴不欲飲

differentiation_zh.variant: 發熱勞則加重，熱勢或高或低
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 熱勢不定，勞累後發作或加重，倦怠氣短、自汗、食少，得臥稍減 —— 內傷發熱，非外感

differentiation_en.variant: Fever and chills together, chills predominant
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Abrupt onset, marked aversion to cold with mild fever, absence of sweating, aching head and body, blocked nose with clear discharge, floating tight pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Fever predominant, chills mild
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Pronounced fever with only slight aversion to cold, sore swollen throat, thirst, thick yellow phlegm, floating rapid pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Afternoon tidal heat with five-centre heat
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Worse in the afternoon or evening, burning palms, soles and chest, night sweats, malar flush, dry mouth and throat; typical of chronic illness or the late stage of a febrile disease

differentiation_en.variant: Unsurfaced heat, worse in the afternoon, heavy head and body
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Skin not obviously hot at first touch but scorching on sustained pressure, worse in the afternoon, heavy head and limbs, stifling fullness in chest and epigastrium, sticky mouth with no thirst or thirst without desire to drink

differentiation_en.variant: Fever worse with exertion, fluctuating in intensity
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Variable intensity, brought on or worsened by exertion, with fatigue, shortness of breath, spontaneous sweating and poor appetite, eased by rest — internal-damage fever, not an external contraction

safety_review_sources: 腦膜炎、敗血症與發熱性嗜中性白血球低下症的通行急症警示準則
不明原因發熱（FUO）的鑑別診斷架構（感染／惡性腫瘤／結締組織疾病）
red_flags_zh: 發熱合併頸項僵硬、畏光、劇烈頭痛 → 排除腦膜炎／腦炎（急症）
發熱合併意識改變、譫妄或抽搐 → 立即送急診
發熱合併皮膚瘀點、瘀斑或紫斑 → 排除腦膜炎雙球菌敗血症（急症）
免疫低下、化療後、脾臟切除或長期類固醇使用者發熱 → 一律視為急症
發熱合併血壓下降、心跳過速、呼吸急促、尿量減少 → 疑敗血症，立即轉診
發熱持續逾三週原因不明，或反覆發熱伴體重減輕、盜汗 → 排除結核、淋巴瘤、感染性心內膜炎
三個月以下嬰兒發熱 → 不做針灸處置，立即轉診
red_flags_en: Fever with neck stiffness, photophobia and severe headache → rule out meningitis/encephalitis (emergency)
Fever with altered consciousness, delirium or seizure → send to emergency immediately
Fever with petechiae, purpura or ecchymoses → rule out meningococcal sepsis (emergency)
Fever in anyone immunosuppressed, post-chemotherapy, asplenic or on long-term steroids → treat as an emergency without exception
Fever with falling blood pressure, tachycardia, tachypnoea or reduced urine output → suspected sepsis, refer immediately
Unexplained fever lasting more than three weeks, or recurrent fever with weight loss and night sweats → rule out tuberculosis, lymphoma, infective endocarditis
Fever in an infant under three months → no acupuncture treatment, refer immediately
sources: 中醫內科學 —— 外感發熱與內傷發熱兩篇；內傷發熱的氣虛／血虛／陰虛／濕鬱／血瘀分證
中醫診斷學 —— 熱型辨證（壯熱・潮熱・身熱不揚・五心煩熱・往來寒熱）
腦膜炎與敗血症通行急症警示準則；發熱性嗜中性白血球低下症處置原則
不明原因發熱（FUO）鑑別診斷架構

records.definition_zh: 入睡困難、睡眠淺易醒、早醒後無法再入睡，或睡眠時數雖足但無恢復感，並影響日間功能。中醫稱「不寐」，是主訴而非診斷 —— 可見於多種證型與多個西醫病名之下。
records.definition_en: Difficulty falling asleep, light or fragmented sleep, early waking without being able to return to sleep, or sleep that fails to restore daytime function despite adequate hours. This is a presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — it appears under many TCM patterns and biomedical conditions.
records.patient_words_zh: 「躺下腦子停不下來」「翻來覆去睡不著」「一點小聲音就醒」「凌晨三四點就醒了，再也睡不著」「睡了八小時還是很累」「怕睡不著，一到晚上就緊張」
records.patient_words_en: "My mind won't switch off when I lie down", "I toss and turn", "the smallest noise wakes me", "I wake at 3 or 4am and can't get back to sleep", "I sleep eight hours and still feel exhausted", "I get anxious about not sleeping as soon as evening comes"

location.why: 失眠非部位性症狀，不需部位軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙（脹刺隱空灼重竄絞酸掣墜麻冷跳），不適用於睡眠障礙的性質描述

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 入睡困難、徹夜不安多屬肝鬱化火或心火亢盛；夜半易醒、多夢多屬陰虛火旺或心膽氣虛；黎明早醒、醒後不能再寐多屬心脾兩虛

inquiry_zh.why: 入睡難、睡中易醒、早醒三種型態分屬不同證型，是本症最有辨證重量的一問
情緒波動、飲濃茶咖啡、輪班、時差、疼痛、更年期、藥物(如類固醇)
何種環境或方法能助眠、白天小睡是否加重夜間失眠
心悸、多夢易驚、五心煩熱、食少便溏、情緒低落或自殺意念——最後一項進紅旗流程
急性失眠(<1個月，常有明確誘因)與慢性失眠(≥3個月，每週≥3晚)處置方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Difficulty falling asleep, mid-sleep waking and early waking map to different patterns — the highest-yield question here
Emotional stress, caffeine/alcohol, shift work, jet lag, pain, menopause, medication (e.g. steroids)
What environment or method helps, and whether daytime napping worsens night sleep
Palpitations, vivid/disturbing dreams, five-centre heat, poor appetite and loose stool, low mood or suicidal ideation — the last enters the red-flag pathway
Acute insomnia (under 1 month, usually with a clear trigger) and chronic insomnia (3+ months, 3+ nights/week) are managed differently

differentiation_zh.variant: 心煩不寐，多夢易驚，口乾便秘
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 入睡困難、徹夜難安，心煩急躁，口舌生瘡，小便短赤，脈數有力

differentiation_zh.variant: 徹夜不寐，急躁易怒，脅脹口苦
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 難以入睡或多夢紛紜，情緒一激動即加重，兼頭脹頭痛、目赤、口苦，脈弦數

differentiation_zh.variant: 多夢易醒，心悸健忘，神疲食少
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 睡眠淺、易醒、多夢，兼心悸、健忘、面色萎黃、食少倦怠，多見於思慮勞心過度者

differentiation_zh.variant: 心煩不寐，心悸，腰膝痠軟，五心煩熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 入夜心煩難寐，兼盜汗、腰膝痠軟、耳鳴、五心煩熱，多見於久病或年長者

differentiation_en.variant: Vexed and unable to sleep, dream-disturbed and easily startled, dry mouth and constipation
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Difficulty falling asleep and restless through the night, irritable and vexed, mouth ulcers, scanty dark urine, forceful rapid pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Sleepless through the night, irritable, hypochondriac fullness and bitter taste
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Difficulty falling asleep or turbulent dreaming, worse with any emotional flare, with distending headache, red eyes, bitter taste, wiry rapid pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Dream-disturbed and easily waking, palpitations and forgetfulness, fatigue and poor appetite
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Light sleep, frequent waking, vivid dreams, with palpitations, forgetfulness, sallow complexion and poor appetite; typically overthinking and overwork

differentiation_en.variant: Vexed and sleepless, palpitations, weak aching low back and knees, five-centre heat
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Restless and unable to sleep at night, with night sweats, weak aching low back and knees, tinnitus and five-centre heat; typically chronic illness or older patients

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus — When to seek emergency care (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm)
red_flags_zh: 失眠合併自殺意念或計畫 → 立即精神科評估／轉診
失眠合併躁狂發作(睡眠需求驟減仍精力旺盛、言語急促、判斷力下降)或精神病症狀(幻覺、妄想) → 精神科緊急評估
嚴重失眠已導致日間功能危險受損(如駕駛、操作機械時嗜睡發作) → 需醫療評估
近期停用酒精、苯二氮平類或安眠藥後出現失眠合併震顫、心悸、焦慮、抽搐 → 排除戒斷症候群，需醫療評估
red_flags_en: Insomnia with suicidal ideation or a plan → immediate psychiatric evaluation/referral
Insomnia with manic symptoms (markedly reduced need for sleep with high energy, pressured speech, impaired judgement) or psychotic symptoms (hallucinations, delusions) → urgent psychiatric evaluation
Severe insomnia causing dangerous daytime impairment (e.g., falling asleep while driving or operating machinery) → medical evaluation needed
New insomnia with tremor, palpitations, anxiety or seizure after recent cessation of alcohol, benzodiazepines or sleep medication → rule out withdrawal syndrome, needs medical evaluation
sources: MedlinePlus — When to seek emergency care (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm)

records.definition_zh: 持續或反覆的精力不足、倦怠感，休息後未能充分緩解，並影響日常活動或工作表現。與單純睡眠不足不同 —— 睡飽仍疲勞才是本症的重點。
records.definition_en: Persistent or recurrent lack of energy and a sense of exhaustion that is not adequately relieved by rest, and that impairs daily activity or work. Distinct from simple sleep deprivation — the defining feature is fatigue that persists even with adequate sleep.
records.patient_words_zh: 「整天都提不起勁」「爬個樓梯就喘、就累」「睡再多還是累」「什麼都不想做」「電池好像永遠充不滿」
records.patient_words_en: "I can't get going all day", "a flight of stairs wipes me out", "I sleep plenty and I'm still exhausted", "I don't feel like doing anything", "my battery never seems to fill up"

location.why: 全身性症狀，無部位軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 晨起即倦怠、動則氣短多屬脾氣虛或陽虛；午後尤甚、肢體困重多屬脾虛濕困；勞累後加重、休息可緩多屬氣血兩虛

inquiry_zh.why: 晨起、午後、勞累後何時最重，指向不同機轉
睡眠品質、情緒、飲食、月經、近期病後或手術後、藥物
休息或睡眠能否緩解 —— 若不能，提示非單純睡眠不足
胸痛、嚴重呼吸困難、暈厥、大出血、高燒或急性神經症狀 —— 進紅旗流程；食少便溏、面色萎黃、心悸提示證型方向
數週內新發與持續數月的慢性疲勞處置方向不同，後者需排查系統性病因

inquiry_en.why: Worst on waking, in the afternoon, or after exertion each points toward a different mechanism
Sleep quality, emotional state, diet, menstruation, recent illness or surgery, medication
Whether rest or sleep relieves it — if not, this argues against simple sleep deprivation

Chest pain, severe dyspnea, syncope, major bleeding, high fever or acute neurologic change enter the red-flag pathway; poor appetite, loose stool, sallow complexion and palpitations point toward pattern differentiation
New fatigue over weeks versus persistent fatigue over months are managed differently — the latter needs a systemic workup

differentiation_zh.variant: 神疲乏力，氣短懶言，食少便溏
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 疲勞感明顯，動則氣短，食慾差、大便溏薄，面色萎黃，脈弱

differentiation_zh.variant: 神疲畏寒，肢冷，腰膝痠軟
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 疲勞兼明顯怕冷、四肢不溫，腰膝痠冷，夜尿頻多，脈沉遲

differentiation_zh.variant: 疲勞面色蒼白，唇甲淡白，心悸頭暈
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 疲勞兼氣血兩虛徵象——面色與唇甲淡白、頭暈心悸、月經量少色淡，脈細弱

differentiation_zh.variant: 疲勞頭身困重，胸悶納呆，苔膩
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 疲勞兼頭重如裹、肢體困重、胸悶脘痞、痰多，陰雨天加重，苔白膩

differentiation_en.variant: Fatigue with shortness of breath, poor appetite and loose stool
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Marked fatigue, breathless on exertion, poor appetite, loose stool, sallow complexion, weak pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Fatigue with cold aversion, cold limbs, weak aching low back and knees
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fatigue with pronounced cold intolerance, cold extremities, aching cold low back and knees, frequent night urination, deep slow pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Fatigue with pale complexion, pale lips and nails, dizziness and palpitations
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fatigue with signs of combined qi-blood deficiency — pale face, lips and nails, dizziness, palpitations, scanty pale menses, thin weak pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Fatigue with heavy head and limbs, chest fullness and poor appetite, greasy coating
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fatigue with heaviness as though wrapped in cloth, heavy limbs, chest and epigastric fullness, copious phlegm, worse in damp weather, white greasy tongue coating

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus — When to seek emergency care (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm)
red_flags_zh: 疲勞合併胸痛、嚴重呼吸困難或暈厥 → 排除心肺急症
疲勞合併明顯出血傾向(黑便、吐血、大量瘀斑) → 需立即醫療評估
疲勞合併高燒或急性神經症狀改變(意識改變、言語不清、肢體無力) → 需緊急評估
疲勞伴隨不明原因明顯體重下降或反覆盜汗、發燒 → 需系統性檢查排除惡性腫瘤、感染或內分泌疾病
red_flags_en: Fatigue with chest pain, severe dyspnea or syncope → rule out cardiopulmonary emergency
Fatigue with signs of significant bleeding (black stool, vomiting blood, extensive bruising) → needs immediate medical evaluation
Fatigue with high fever or acute neurologic change (altered consciousness, slurred speech, limb weakness) → needs urgent evaluation
Fatigue with unexplained significant weight loss or recurrent night sweats and fever → needs systemic workup to rule out malignancy, infection or endocrine disease
sources: MedlinePlus — When to seek emergency care (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm)
MedlinePlus — Emergency medical services (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/001927.htm)

records.definition_zh: 腰部(肋緣下至臀褶之間)的疼痛，可牽連下肢或局限於腰部。是主訴而非診斷，可見於肌肉筋膜勞損、椎間盤病變、腎系疾病乃至內臟轉移痛等多種病因之下。
records.definition_en: Pain in the lower back, between the lower ribs and the gluteal fold, with or without referral into the leg. A presenting complaint rather than a diagnosis, seen with myofascial strain, disc pathology, renal disease and even referred visceral pain.
records.patient_words_zh: 「腰一直酸酸的」「彎腰就痛」「早上起床特別僵硬，動一動才鬆開」「痛到腿麻」「像被人捶了一拳」「坐久了才痛，站起來反而好一點」
records.patient_words_en: "My lower back is always achy", "it hurts when I bend forward", "stiff first thing in the morning, loosens up once I move", "the pain shoots down my leg and it goes numb", "like someone punched me there", "it only hurts after sitting a while, standing up actually helps"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 痠痛屬腎虛 · 刺痛屬血瘀 · 冷痛屬寒濕 · 脹痛屬氣滯

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 晨起僵硬活動後緩解，多見於勞損；久坐或勞累後加重多屬腎虛；遇陰雨寒冷加重多屬寒濕

inquiry_zh.why: 正中督脈、兩側膀胱經、單側或雙側，牽連臀腿與否，決定循經取穴與是否考慮神經根性病變
痠痛、刺痛、冷痛、脹痛分屬四種病機
晨僵活動後緩解、久坐久站加重、遇寒加重各有指向
搬重物、久坐、外傷、受寒、月經週期
按之減輕屬虛、拒按屬實、得溫則減屬寒、平躺屈膝是否緩解
下肢麻木無力、大小便功能改變、鞍區感覺喪失 —— 這些進紅旗流程
急性新發(尤其外傷後)與慢性反覆的處置與轉診門檻不同

inquiry_en.why: Midline (Du channel), bilateral paraspinal (Bladder channel), one-sided, and whether it refers into the buttock/leg — this drives channel selection and whether to suspect a radicular cause
Aching, stabbing, cold and distending pain map to four different mechanisms
Morning stiffness that loosens with movement, worse with prolonged sitting/standing, or worse in cold damp weather each point somewhere different
Heavy lifting, prolonged sitting, trauma, cold exposure, menstrual cycle
Better for pressure = deficiency, worse for pressure = excess, better for warmth = cold, whether lying with knees bent helps
Leg numbness or weakness, new bowel/bladder change, saddle anesthesia — these enter the red-flag pathway
Acute new-onset (especially post-trauma) and chronic recurrent pain carry different thresholds for referral

differentiation_zh.variant: 腰部隱痛痠軟，喜按喜溫，遇勞加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 痠痛綿綿，喜溫喜按，遇勞更甚，臥則減輕，兼畏寒肢冷、夜尿頻多

differentiation_zh.variant: 腰痛而熱，午後潮熱，五心煩熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腰部痠痛兼熱感，遇勞加重，兼顴紅盜汗、口乾咽燥、失眠

differentiation_zh.variant: 腰部冷痛重著，陰雨加重，轉側不利
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腰部冷痛沉重，遇陰雨寒冷明顯加重，得溫痛減，肢體轉側不利

differentiation_zh.variant: 腰痛如刺，痛處固定，拒按，夜間加重

red_flags_zh: 下背痛合併新發大小便失禁或滯留、鞍區(會陰)麻木 → 排除馬尾症候群，急症轉診

Low back pain with progressive or marked leg weakness → needs urgent neurologic evaluation
Low back pain with fever, or a history of cancer, immunosuppression or recent infection → rule out spinal infection or malignancy
Low back pain after major trauma → rule out fracture
Low back pain with unexplained weight loss, or night pain that wakes the patient and is not relieved → needs further workup to rule out malignancy

records.definition_zh: 頸部(枕骨下緣至第一胸椎之間)的疼痛，可伴隨活動受限或牽連肩臂。是主訴而非診斷，可見於落枕、頸椎病、外傷乃至少數轉移痛之下。
records.definition_en: Pain in the neck, from the base of the skull to the first thoracic vertebra, with or without restricted movement or referral into the shoulder/arm. A presenting complaint rather than a diagnosis, seen with acute torticollis, cervical spondylosis, trauma and occasionally referred pain.
records.patient_words_zh: 「脖子轉不過去」「早上起來落枕了」「一直維持同一個姿勢就緊繃」「痛到手臂會麻」「肩頸像壓了一塊石頭」
records.patient_words_en: "I can't turn my neck", "I woke up with a crick in my neck", "it gets tight if I hold one position too long", "the pain shoots into my arm and it goes numb", "it feels like there's a rock sitting on my shoulders and neck"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 脹痛屬氣滯或風邪 · 刺痛屬血瘀 · 痠痛屬勞損或氣血不足

inquiry_zh.why: 正中督脈、單側或雙側，是否牽連肩臂或伴隨上肢麻木
脹痛、刺痛、痠痛分屬不同病機
晨起僵硬、久坐低頭加重、遇風加重各有指向
睡姿不良、久坐低頭(手機頸)、受風受寒、外傷、情緒緊張
熱敷是否緩解、活動後是否鬆開
上肢麻木無力、頭暈、頭痛、發熱頸僵 —— 進紅旗流程
急性落枕(數日)與慢性反覆頸痛處置不同

inquiry_en.why: Midline, one-sided or bilateral, and whether it refers into the shoulder/arm with numbness
Distending, stabbing and aching pain map to different mechanisms
Morning stiffness, worse with prolonged forward-head posture, worse in a draught
Poor sleep posture, prolonged screen/phone use, wind-cold exposure, trauma, emotional tension
Whether heat helps, whether movement loosens it
Arm numbness or weakness, dizziness, headache, fever with neck stiffness — these enter the red-flag pathway
Acute torticollis (days) and chronic recurrent neck pain are handled differently

differentiation_zh.variant: 頸項強痛，惡風寒，遇風加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 起病急，頸項強痛拘急，遇風寒加重，得溫痛減，或兼頭痛惡寒

differentiation_zh.variant: 頸肩痠痛麻木，遇勞加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 頸肩痠痛綿綿，勞累後加重，兼手臂麻木、頭暈、面色少華

differentiation_zh.variant: 頸項刺痛，痛處固定，轉側不利
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 痛處固定不移，拒按，轉側不利，多有外傷或長期姿勢不良史

differentiation_zh.variant: 頸部脹痛，情緒波動加重，兼胸脅悶
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 頸部脹痛隨情緒起伏，兼胸脅脹悶、善太息

differentiation_en.variant: Stiff tight neck pain, aversion to wind-cold, worse in a draught
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Abrupt onset, stiff tight neck pain, worse in wind or cold, better for warmth, may accompany headache and chills

differentiation_en.variant: Aching numb neck and shoulder, worse with exertion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vague continuous ache, worse after exertion, with arm numbness, dizziness, pale complexion

differentiation_en.variant: Stabbing neck pain, fixed location, stiff on turning
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fixed unmoving pain, worse for pressure, stiff on turning, often a history of trauma or long-standing poor posture

differentiation_en.variant: Distending neck pain, worse with emotional swings, chest/hypochondriac fullness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Distending pain that tracks emotional state, with chest and hypochondriac fullness, frequent sighing

red_flags_zh: 重大外傷後頸痛 → 排除頸椎骨折／脊髓損傷，切勿隨意搬動或手法治療
頸痛合併新發上肢無力、麻木或步態改變 → 需緊急神經學評估
頸痛合併發熱、頸項僵硬拒按、畏光 → 排除腦膜炎
頸痛突發劇烈，性質與以往完全不同(撕裂樣) → 排除頸動脈剝離等血管病變
red_flags_en: Neck pain after major trauma → rule out cervical fracture/spinal cord injury; do not manipulate or move the neck freely
Neck pain with new arm weakness, numbness or gait change → needs urgent neurologic evaluation
Neck pain with fever, marked neck stiffness on passive flexion, photophobia → rule out meningitis
Sudden severe neck pain of a completely different character from before (tearing quality) → rule out vascular causes such as arterial dissection
sources: MedlinePlus — Emergency medical services (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/001927.htm)
CDC — Stroke signs and symptoms (https://www.cdc.gov/stroke/signs-symptoms/index.html)

records.definition_zh: 肩關節及周圍軟組織的疼痛，可伴活動受限。是主訴而非診斷，可見於肩周炎、肌腱病變、外傷，少數情形是心臟或橫膈病變的轉移痛。
records.definition_en: Pain in the shoulder joint or surrounding soft tissue, with or without restricted movement. A presenting complaint rather than a diagnosis, seen with frozen shoulder, tendinopathy, trauma, and occasionally as referred pain from cardiac or diaphragmatic disease.
records.patient_words_zh: 「手舉不上去」「穿外套很痛」「晚上睡覺壓到就痛醒」「肩膀卡卡的」「痛到沒辦法梳頭」
records.patient_words_en: "I can't lift my arm", "it hurts to put on a jacket", "it wakes me up if I roll onto it at night", "my shoulder feels stuck", "I can't reach up to brush my hair"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 冷痛屬寒濕 · 刺痛屬血瘀 · 痠痛屬氣血不足 · 脹痛屬氣滯

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 夜間痛甚影響睡眠，是肩周炎常見表現；遇寒加重多屬寒濕

inquiry_zh.why: 肩前、肩外側、肩後或整個肩關節，牽連上臂與否
冷痛、刺痛、痠痛、脹痛分屬四種病機
夜間痛甚、遇寒加重、活動初期加重活動後反鬆
外傷、受寒、久未活動(如術後臥床)、反覆過度使用
熱敷是否緩解、活動範圍受限程度
胸痛、呼吸困難、冒冷汗 —— 需排除心因性轉移痛，進紅旗流程
急性外傷後與慢性反覆(肩周炎病程數月至年餘)處置不同

inquiry_en.why: Anterior, lateral or posterior shoulder, or the whole joint, and whether it refers down the arm
Cold, stabbing, aching and distending pain map to four different mechanisms
Worse at night, worse in cold weather, or worse at the start of movement and easing with continued motion
Trauma, cold exposure, prolonged immobility (e.g. post-surgical bed rest), repetitive overuse
Whether heat helps, and the degree of restricted range of motion
Chest pain, dyspnea, cold sweat — must rule out cardiac referred pain; enters the red-flag pathway
Acute post-traumatic pain and chronic recurrent pain (frozen shoulder runs months to over a year) are managed differently

differentiation_zh.variant: 肩部冷痛，遇寒加重，得溫則舒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肩部冷痛沉重，遇風寒陰雨加重，得溫痛減，活動受限

differentiation_zh.variant: 肩痛夜甚，痛處固定不移，拒按
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 痛處固定，拒按，夜間痛甚影響睡眠，多有外傷或勞損史

differentiation_zh.variant: 肩臂痠軟無力，遇勞加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肩臂痠軟無力，勞累後加重，兼氣短懶言、面色少華

differentiation_zh.variant: 肩部脹痛，活動受限，情緒波動加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肩部脹痛隨情緒起伏，兼胸脅脹悶、善太息

differentiation_en.variant: Cold shoulder pain, worse in cold weather, better for warmth
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Cold heavy shoulder pain, markedly worse in wind, cold or damp weather, better for warmth, restricted movement

differentiation_en.variant: Shoulder pain worse at night, fixed location, worse for pressure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fixed unmoving pain, worse for pressure, worse at night and disturbing sleep, often a history of trauma or overuse

differentiation_en.variant: Aching weak shoulder and arm, worse with exertion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Aching weakness in the shoulder and arm, worse after exertion, with shortness of breath and pale complexion

differentiation_en.variant: Distending shoulder pain, restricted movement, worse with emotional swings
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Distending pain that tracks emotional state, with chest and hypochondriac fullness, frequent sighing

red_flags_zh: 肩痛(尤其左肩或雙肩)合併胸痛、胸悶、冒冷汗、呼吸困難或暈厥 → 排除急性冠心症候群，立即就醫
肩痛伴大重大外傷、明顯畸形或無法活動 → 排除骨折或脫臼
肩痛合併神經血管功能受損徵象(手部麻木發白、脈搏消失) → 需緊急評估
red_flags_en: Shoulder pain (especially left or bilateral) with chest pain, tightness, cold sweat, dyspnea or syncope → rule out acute coronary syndrome, seek care immediately
Shoulder pain with major trauma, visible deformity or inability to move the joint → rule out fracture or dislocation
Shoulder pain with signs of neurovascular compromise (pale numb hand, absent pulse) → needs urgent assessment
sources: MedlinePlus — Emergency medical services (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/001927.htm)

records.definition_zh: 非旋轉性的頭部昏沉、輕飄或站立不穩感，與眩暈(明確旋轉感)不同 —— 兩者常被病人混用，問診時需分辨。是主訴而非診斷。
records.definition_en: A non-spinning sense of light-headedness, wooziness or unsteadiness, distinct from vertigo (a definite spinning sensation) — patients frequently conflate the two, so distinguishing them is part of the history. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis.
records.patient_words_zh: 「頭重重的」「昏昏沉沉」「站起來會晃一下」「腦袋不清楚」「輕飄飄的，好像要暈倒」
records.patient_words_en: "My head feels heavy", "foggy and woozy", "I sway a bit when I stand up", "my head isn't clear", "light-headed, like I might pass out"

location.why: 全頭性感受，無局部部位軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，頭暈的性質軸(昏沉、輕飄、搖晃)不在其中

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 起立時發作提示體位性因素；勞累後加重多屬氣血兩虛；午後或情緒波動後加重多屬肝陽

inquiry_zh.why: 起立時、勞累後、情緒波動後何時發作，指向不同機轉
起身過快、空腹、睡眠不足、情緒、月經期、近期感冒
坐下或平躺是否緩解、進食是否緩解(提示低血糖相關)
單側肢體無力、言語不清、視覺改變、劇烈頭痛、步態不穩 —— 進紅旗流程；耳鳴腰痠提示腎虛，胸悶苔膩提示痰濕
突發與慢性反覆處置方向不同，突發合併神經症狀需優先排除腦血管意外

inquiry_en.why: On standing, after exertion, or after emotional upset each points toward a different mechanism
Standing up quickly, fasting, sleep deprivation, emotion, menstruation, recent cold/flu
Whether sitting or lying down helps, whether eating helps (suggests hypoglycemia)

One-sided weakness, slurred speech, visual change, severe headache, unsteady gait enter the red-flag pathway; tinnitus and low back ache suggest kidney deficiency, chest fullness and greasy coating suggest phlegm-damp
Sudden onset and chronic recurrent dizziness are managed differently — sudden onset with neurologic symptoms must first rule out cerebrovascular events

differentiation_zh.variant: 頭暈脹痛，煩躁易怒，面紅目赤
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 頭暈兼脹痛感，情緒波動或熬夜後加重，兼面紅目赤、急躁易怒、腰膝痠軟

differentiation_zh.variant: 頭暈眼花，勞累加重，面色蒼白
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 頭暈眼花，動則加重，勞累後尤甚，兼神疲乏力、心悸、面色淡白

differentiation_zh.variant: 頭暈昏蒙，如物遮蓋，胸悶噁心
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 頭暈昏沉如有物蒙蔽，兼胸悶脘痞、噁心欲吐、痰多，苔白膩

differentiation_zh.variant: 頭暈耳鳴，腰膝痠軟，健忘
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 頭暈兼耳鳴、健忘、腰膝痠軟、齒搖髮脫，多見於久病或年長者

differentiation_en.variant: Dizziness with distending sensation, irritability, red face and eyes
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dizziness with a distending quality, worse with emotional swings or late nights, with red face and eyes, irritability, weak aching low back and knees

differentiation_en.variant: Dizziness with blurred vision, worse after exertion, pale complexion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dizziness with blurred vision, worse on standing/exertion, with fatigue, palpitations, pale complexion

differentiation_en.variant: Muzzy dizziness as though covered, chest fullness and nausea
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Heavy foggy dizziness as though under a covering, with chest and epigastric fullness, nausea, copious phlegm, white greasy coating

differentiation_en.variant: Dizziness with tinnitus, weak aching low back and knees, forgetfulness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dizziness with tinnitus, forgetfulness, weak aching low back and knees, loosening teeth and hair loss; usually chronic illness or older patients

red_flags_zh: 頭暈合併單側肢體無力或麻木、言語不清、臉部歪斜 → 排除腦中風，立即送急診
頭暈合併視覺改變、複視、行走困難 → 需緊急神經學評估
突發劇烈頭暈合併嚴重頭痛 → 排除顱內出血
頭暈合併胸痛、心悸、暈厥 → 排除心因性病因
red_flags_en: Dizziness with one-sided limb weakness or numbness, slurred speech, facial droop → rule out stroke, send to emergency immediately
Dizziness with visual change, double vision, or difficulty walking → needs urgent neurologic evaluation
Sudden severe dizziness with severe headache → rule out intracranial hemorrhage
Dizziness with chest pain, palpitations or syncope → rule out cardiac cause
sources: CDC — Stroke signs and symptoms (https://www.cdc.gov/stroke/signs-symptoms/index.html)

records.definition_zh: 明確的旋轉或搖晃感，覺得自身或周圍環境在轉動，常合併噁心嘔吐、站立不穩。與頭暈(非旋轉性昏沉)不同，需在問診時明確分辨。是主訴而非診斷。
records.definition_en: A definite spinning or swaying sensation, of the self or the surroundings rotating, often with nausea, vomiting and unsteadiness. Distinct from dizziness (non-spinning light-headedness), and the distinction must be made explicit during history-taking. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis.
records.patient_words_zh: 「天旋地轉」「房間在轉」「像坐船一樣搖」「一動就想吐」「閉眼睛比較不會轉」
records.patient_words_en: "The room is spinning", "everything is whirling around me", "it feels like I'm on a boat", "any movement makes me want to vomit", "it's better with my eyes closed"

location.why: 全頭性感受，無局部部位軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，眩暈的性質軸(旋轉感、搖晃感)不在其中

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 轉頭或改變體位誘發，提示前庭因素；勞累後加重多屬氣血兩虛

inquiry_zh.why: 轉頭誘發、勞累後加重、情緒波動後加重指向不同機轉
頭部姿勢改變、近期感冒、耳部感染史、情緒
靜臥閉眼是否緩解、發作持續時間(數秒、數分鐘、數小時)
耳鳴耳聾、噁心嘔吐是常見伴隨；單側肢體無力、複視、言語不清、劇烈頭痛則進紅旗流程
陣發性(數秒至數分鐘)與持續性眩暈的鑑別方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Triggered by head turning, worse after exertion, or worse after emotional upset each points somewhere different
Change in head position, recent cold/flu, history of ear infection, emotion
Whether lying still with eyes closed helps, and how long episodes last (seconds, minutes, hours)
Tinnitus and hearing loss are common companions; one-sided weakness, double vision, slurred speech or severe headache enter the red-flag pathway
Episodic (seconds to minutes) versus persistent vertigo point toward different causes

differentiation_zh.variant: 眩暈欲仆，兼耳鳴，肢體震顫
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 眩暈劇烈欲仆倒，兼耳鳴、肢體震顫或麻木，情緒激動或血壓驟升時發作

differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 眩暈劇烈伴視物旋轉、噁心嘔吐痰涎，胸悶脘痞，苔白膩

differentiation_zh.variant: 眩暈勞則加重，面色淡白，心悸
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 眩暈遇勞加重，動則尤甚，兼心悸、面色淡白、神疲乏力

differentiation_zh.variant: 眩暈耳鳴，腰膝痠軟，遺精
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 眩暈反覆發作，兼耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、男子遺精女子帶下，多見於久病或年長者

differentiation_en.variant: Severe vertigo with a sense of falling, tinnitus, tremor
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Severe vertigo with a sense of near-collapse, tinnitus, limb tremor or numbness, triggered by strong emotion or a surge in blood pressure

differentiation_en.variant: Spinning vision, nausea and vomiting, chest fullness and greasy coating
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Severe vertigo with a spinning visual sensation, nausea, vomiting of phlegm-fluid, chest and epigastric fullness, white greasy coating

differentiation_en.variant: Vertigo worse with exertion, pale complexion, palpitations
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vertigo worse with exertion, worse on movement, with palpitations, pale complexion, fatigue

differentiation_en.variant: Vertigo with tinnitus, weak aching low back and knees, seminal emission
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Recurrent vertigo with tinnitus, weak aching low back and knees, seminal emission in men or abnormal discharge in women; usually chronic illness or older patients

red_flags_zh: 眩暈合併新發神經功能缺損(複視、構音障礙、單側無力、步態不穩、共濟失調) → 排除後循環中風
眩暈合併劇烈頭痛，性質與以往不同 → 需緊急影像評估
眩暈合併突發單側聽力喪失 → 需緊急耳鼻喉科評估
眩暈完全無法緩解、持續加重且合併意識改變 → 立即送急診
red_flags_en: Vertigo with new focal neurologic deficit (double vision, dysarthria, one-sided weakness, unsteady gait, ataxia) → rule out posterior circulation stroke
Vertigo with a severe headache unlike any before → needs urgent imaging evaluation
Vertigo with sudden one-sided hearing loss → needs urgent ENT evaluation
Vertigo that will not settle, keeps worsening, and comes with altered consciousness → send to emergency immediately
sources: CDC — Stroke signs and symptoms (https://www.cdc.gov/stroke/signs-symptoms/index.html)

records.definition_zh: 在無外部聲源的情況下，自覺耳中或頭中有鳴響、嗡嗡、蟬鳴或潮聲等聲音。是主訴而非診斷，可為單側或雙側，可急可慢。
records.definition_en: A perceived sound in the ear or head — ringing, buzzing, cicada-like or roaring — without any external sound source. A presenting complaint rather than a diagnosis, may be one- or two-sided, acute or chronic.
records.patient_words_zh: 「耳朵一直有聲音」「像蟬叫」「嗡嗡的」「安靜的時候特別明顯」「像海浪聲」

laterality.diagnostic_note_zh: 單側耳鳴合併聽力驟降需優先排除突發性耳聾等急症；雙側慢性耳鳴多屬虛證

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 安靜夜間明顯多屬虛；突發劇烈多屬實／肝火；勞累後加重多屬脾腎兩虛

inquiry_zh.why: 蟬鳴聲細多屬虛，潮聲如雷轟鳴多屬實(肝火、痰火)
安靜時明顯、勞累後加重、突發與否指向不同證型
情緒、勞累、噪音暴露史、藥物(耳毒性藥物)、感冒後
按壓耳周或安靜環境是否改變音量
聽力下降、耳悶脹感、眩暈 —— 常見伴隨；突發單側聽力喪失、新發神經症狀進紅旗流程
急性(數日內)與慢性(數月以上)耳鳴的轉診急迫性不同

inquiry_en.why: A fine cicada-like tone suggests deficiency; a loud roaring/thunderous tone suggests excess (liver fire, phlegm-fire)
Noticeable in quiet settings, worse after exertion, or sudden onset each point toward a different pattern
Emotion, exertion, noise exposure history, ototoxic medication, after a cold
Whether pressing around the ear or a quiet environment changes the volume
Hearing loss, ear fullness, vertigo are common companions; sudden one-sided hearing loss or new neurologic symptoms enter the red-flag pathway
Acute (days) versus chronic (months or more) tinnitus carries a different urgency for referral

differentiation_zh.variant: 耳鳴時輕時重，神疲乏力，食少
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 耳鳴時輕時重，勞累後加重，兼神疲乏力、食少便溏、面色萎黃

differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 耳鳴兼耳中脹悶如塞，頭重如裹，胸悶噁心，苔白膩

differentiation_en.variant: Sudden loud roaring tinnitus, irritability, red face
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Loud roaring tinnitus, sudden onset or abrupt worsening, with distending headache, red face and eyes, bitter taste, irritability

differentiation_en.variant: Fine cicada-like tinnitus, gradual onset, worse with exertion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fine cicada-like tone, gradually progressive, noticeable in quiet at night, with weak aching low back and knees, dizziness, forgetfulness

differentiation_en.variant: Tinnitus fluctuating in intensity, fatigue, poor appetite
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fluctuating tinnitus, worse after exertion, with fatigue, poor appetite, loose stool, sallow complexion

differentiation_en.variant: Tinnitus with a blocked stuffy sensation, heavy head, chest fullness

red_flags_zh: 突發單側聽力顯著喪失合併耳鳴 → 屬耳鼻喉科急症(突發性耳聾)，需 72 小時內就醫
耳鳴合併新發神經功能缺損(臉部麻木、複視、步態不穩) → 需緊急神經學評估
與脈搏同步的搏動性耳鳴 → 需影像評估排除血管性病因
耳鳴合併頭部外傷史或耳道流血流膿 → 需耳鼻喉科評估
red_flags_en: Sudden marked one-sided hearing loss with tinnitus → an ENT emergency (sudden sensorineural hearing loss), needs care within 72 hours
Tinnitus with new focal neurologic deficit (facial numbness, double vision, unsteady gait) → needs urgent neurologic evaluation
Pulsatile tinnitus synchronized with the heartbeat → needs imaging to rule out a vascular cause
Tinnitus with a history of head trauma or ear discharge/bleeding → needs ENT evaluation

records.definition_zh: 自覺心臟跳動異常 —— 快、慢、漏跳或用力搏動的不適感。是主訴，不等於心律不整的診斷，客觀心律需靠心電圖等檢查確認，屬病例層。
records.definition_en: A subjective awareness of the heartbeat — racing, slow, skipping or pounding. A presenting complaint, not the same as a diagnosis of arrhythmia; the objective rhythm requires ECG or similar and belongs to the case layer.
records.patient_words_zh: 「心臟跳得很快」「心臟好像漏跳一拍」「心慌慌的」「感覺心臟在敲」「一緊張心跳就亂」
records.patient_words_en: "My heart is racing", "it feels like my heart skipped a beat", "a fluttery uneasy feeling in my chest", "I can feel my heart pounding", "my heartbeat goes erratic when I'm anxious"

location.why: 胸部正中，已由 taxonomy_ids 定位，無需再細分部位

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，心悸的性質軸(快、慢、漏跳、搏動有力與否)不在其中

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 夜間發作或影響入睡多屬陰血不足；勞累後或情緒激動後發作多屬氣虛或心陽不振

inquiry_zh.why: 夜間、勞累後、情緒激動後何時發作，指向不同機轉
咖啡因、情緒、勞累、發燒、貧血、甲狀腺疾病、藥物、月經期
休息是否緩解、深呼吸或按壓是否改變
胸痛、暈厥或暈厥前兆、嚴重呼吸困難、冒冷汗 —— 進紅旗流程；善驚易恐、多夢、五心煩熱提示證型方向
陣發性(數秒至數分鐘)與持續性心悸的鑑別方向不同

inquiry_en.why: At night, after exertion, or after emotional upset each points toward a different mechanism
Caffeine, emotion, exertion, fever, anemia, thyroid disease, medication, menstruation
Whether rest helps, whether deep breathing or vagal maneuvers change it
Chest pain, syncope or presyncope, severe dyspnea, cold sweat enter the red-flag pathway; being easily startled, vivid dreams and five-centre heat point toward pattern differentiation
Episodic (seconds to minutes) versus persistent palpitations point toward different causes

differentiation_zh.variant: 心悸善驚，坐臥不安，寐差多夢
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 心悸易受驚嚇，坐臥不安，遇事易恐，寐差多夢，兼氣短乏力

differentiation_zh.variant: 心悸氣短，畏寒肢冷，遇冷加重

differentiation_zh.variant: 心悸胸悶刺痛，唇甲紫暗
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 心悸兼胸部刺痛或悶痛，痛處固定，唇甲紫暗，舌質紫暗或有瘀斑

differentiation_en.variant: Palpitations with easy startling, restlessness, poor sleep with dreams
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Palpitations easily triggered by fright, restless, easily fearful, poor sleep with dreaming, with shortness of breath and fatigue

differentiation_en.variant: Palpitations with dizziness, pale complexion, pale lips and nails
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Palpitations with dizziness and blurred vision, pale lustreless complexion, lips and nails, insomnia, forgetfulness

differentiation_en.variant: Palpitations with shortness of breath, cold aversion and cold limbs, worse in cold
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Palpitations with chest fullness and shortness of breath, cold aversion, cold limbs, worse in cold weather and with exertion, may show pale complexion and spontaneous sweating

differentiation_en.variant: Palpitations with chest fullness and stabbing pain, dusky lips and nails
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Palpitations with fixed stabbing or oppressive chest pain, dusky lips and nails, dusky tongue or with stasis spots

red_flags_zh: 心悸合併暈厥或近乎暈厥 → 需緊急心臟科評估
心悸合併胸痛、嚴重呼吸困難 → 排除急性心臟事件，立即就醫
心悸合併持續性血流動力學不穩(冒冷汗、意識模糊、血壓下降) → 立即送急診
心悸合併已知心臟病史或明顯心律不規則且持續不緩解 → 需心臟科評估
red_flags_en: Palpitations with syncope or near-syncope → needs urgent cardiology evaluation
Palpitations with chest pain or severe dyspnea → rule out acute cardiac event, seek care immediately
Palpitations with sustained hemodynamic instability (cold sweat, confusion, falling blood pressure) → send to emergency immediately
Palpitations with a known cardiac history, or a markedly irregular rhythm that does not settle → needs cardiology evaluation

records.definition_zh: 上腹部及咽喉部的不適感，伴有想嘔吐的衝動，可有或無實際嘔吐。是主訴而非診斷，病因跨消化、神經、內分泌、妊娠與藥物等多個系統。
records.definition_en: An unpleasant sensation in the upper abdomen and throat with an urge to vomit, with or without actual vomiting. A presenting complaint rather than a diagnosis, with causes spanning digestive, neurologic, endocrine, pregnancy-related and drug-related origins.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一直想吐」「胃翻攪的」「反胃」「喉嚨口有東西頂著」「聞到味道就想吐」
records.patient_words_en: "I keep feeling like I'm going to be sick", "my stomach is churning", "queasy", "there's something rising in my throat", "certain smells make me want to gag"

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用於噁心

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 食後即發多屬食滯或胃熱；晨起明顯需考慮妊娠；情緒波動後發作多屬肝胃不和

inquiry_zh.why: 食後、晨起、情緒波動後發作各有指向
飲食(過飽、油膩)、情緒、暈車暈船、妊娠可能性、藥物(化療、鴉片類)
嘔吐後是否緩解、進食少量是否改善
持續嘔吐、吐血或咖啡渣樣物、劇烈腹痛、意識改變、明顯脫水 —— 進紅旗流程；口苦脅脹提示肝胃不和，噯腐吞酸提示食滯
急性(數小時至數日)與慢性反覆噁心的鑑別方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Occurring right after eating, on waking, or after emotional upset each points somewhere different
Diet (overeating, greasy food), emotion, motion sickness, possible pregnancy, medication (chemotherapy, opioids)
Whether vomiting relieves it, whether small frequent meals help

Persistent vomiting, hematemesis or coffee-ground emesis, severe abdominal pain, altered mental status, significant dehydration enter the red-flag pathway; bitter taste and hypochondriac fullness suggest liver-stomach disharmony, sour belching suggests food stagnation
Acute (hours to days) versus chronic recurrent nausea point toward different causes

differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 噁心兼噯氣酸腐，脘腹脹滿拒按，厭食，或有暴飲暴食史

differentiation_zh.variant: 噁心脅脹，噯氣頻作，情緒波動加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 噁心隨情緒起伏，兼脅肋脹悶、噯氣頻作、善太息

differentiation_en.distinguishing: Nausea with epigastric fullness, bland taste without thirst, heavy limbs, white greasy coating, worse with cold or raw/cold food

differentiation_en.variant: Nausea with bitter taste, epigastric fullness and acid regurgitation, yellow greasy coating
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Nausea with a bitter sticky taste, epigastric fullness, acid regurgitation and gnawing hunger, yellow greasy coating, scanty dark urine

differentiation_en.variant: Nausea with sour belching, abdominal distension, loss of appetite
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Nausea with sour rotten belching, distended abdomen worse for pressure, loss of appetite, often a history of overeating

differentiation_en.variant: Nausea with hypochondriac fullness, frequent belching, worse with emotional swings
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Nausea that tracks emotional state, with hypochondriac fullness, frequent belching, frequent sighing

records.definition_zh: 腹部脹滿或緊繃感，可伴隨可見的腹部膨隆。病人先察覺的是「衣服變緊」，醫者可望診或觸診確認腹部膨隆與叩診鼓音，是本症兼具自述與他覺兩種取得型態的原因。是主訴而非診斷。
records.definition_en: A sensation of fullness or tightness in the abdomen, with or without visible distension. The patient notices tight clothing first; the examiner can confirm visible distension and tympanic percussion — which is why this symptom carries both observation modes. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis.
records.patient_words_zh: 「肚子脹得像氣球」「褲子扣不上」「吃一點就撐」「肚子裡都是氣」「一直想打嗝放屁」
records.patient_words_en: "My belly feels blown up like a balloon", "I can't do my trousers up", "I feel full after a few bites", "it feels like my stomach is full of gas", "I keep needing to burp or pass gas"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 脹屬氣滯，是本症最直接對應的性質詞

laterality.why: 腹部脹滿多為瀰漫性，非側性症狀

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 食後即脹多屬食滯或脾虛；經前加重提示衝任與肝；情緒波動後加重多屬肝鬱氣滯

inquiry_zh.why: 上腹、下腹或全腹脹滿，脹滿部位提示不同臟腑
脹滿隨噯氣或矢氣後是否緩解，是氣滯與否的關鍵
食後、經前、情緒波動後何時加重
飲食(產氣食物、進食過快)、情緒、月經週期、久坐少動
噯氣或矢氣後是否緩解、按摩是否改善
劇烈疼痛、持續嘔吐、無法排氣排便、消化道出血 —— 進紅旗流程；食少便溏提示脾虛
急性新發與慢性反覆(如經前週期性)處置方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Upper, lower or whole-abdomen fullness suggests different organ systems
Whether the fullness eases after belching or passing gas is the key marker of qi stagnation
Worse after eating, premenstrually, or after emotional upset
Diet (gas-producing food, eating too fast), emotion, menstrual cycle, prolonged sitting
Whether belching or passing gas relieves it, whether massage helps
Severe pain, persistent vomiting, inability to pass gas or stool, GI bleeding enter the red-flag pathway; poor appetite and loose stool suggest spleen deficiency
Acute new-onset versus chronic recurrent (e.g. cyclical premenstrual) bloating are managed differently

differentiation_zh.variant: 脘腹脹滿，噯腐吞酸，不欲飲食
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 脘腹脹滿拒按，噯氣酸腐，厭食，或有暴飲暴食史，瀉後或矢氣後稍減

differentiation_zh.variant: 腹脹隨情緒增減，噯氣則舒，脅肋脹悶
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腹脹隨情緒起伏，噯氣或矢氣後緩解，兼脅肋脹悶、善太息

differentiation_zh.variant: 腹脹食少，便溏，神疲肢倦
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腹脹綿綿，食後尤甚，兼食少、便溏、神疲乏力、面色萎黃

differentiation_zh.variant: 腹脹痞悶，口黏不渴，苔厚膩
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腹脹兼脘痞不舒，口黏不渴，肢體困重，苔白厚膩

differentiation_en.variant: Epigastric and abdominal fullness, sour rotten belching, loss of appetite
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Distension worse for pressure, sour rotten belching, loss of appetite, often a history of overeating, slightly relieved after a bowel movement or passing gas

differentiation_en.variant: Bloating that tracks emotional state, eased by belching, hypochondriac fullness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Bloating that rises and falls with mood, relieved by belching or passing gas, with hypochondriac fullness, frequent sighing

differentiation_en.variant: Bloating with poor appetite, loose stool, fatigue
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vague continuous bloating, worse after eating, with poor appetite, loose stool, fatigue, sallow complexion

differentiation_en.variant: Bloating with stuffy fullness, sticky mouth without thirst, thick greasy coating
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Bloating with epigastric stuffiness, sticky mouth without thirst, heavy limbs, thick white greasy coating

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus — When to seek emergency care (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm)
red_flags_zh: 腹脹明顯合併劇烈疼痛、持續嘔吐、完全無法排氣排便 → 排除腸阻塞，急症轉診
腹脹合併消化道出血徵象(吐血、黑便) → 需緊急評估
腹脹合併休克症狀(冒冷汗、心跳過速、意識模糊) → 立即送急診
腹脹合併不明原因體重下降或腹部可觸及腫塊 → 需進一步檢查
red_flags_en: Marked bloating with severe pain, persistent vomiting, complete inability to pass gas or stool → rule out bowel obstruction, urgent referral
Bloating with signs of GI bleeding (hematemesis, black stool) → needs urgent evaluation
Bloating with signs of shock (cold sweat, tachycardia, confusion) → send to emergency immediately
Bloating with unexplained weight loss or a palpable abdominal mass → needs further workup
sources: MedlinePlus — Emergency medical services (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/001927.htm)
MedlinePlus — When to seek emergency care (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm)

inquiry_zh.why: 排便頻率、糞質軟硬(Bristol 分型)屬病例層量化，問診仍需先掌握大致情況以判斷急迫性
飲水量、纖維攝取、活動量、藥物(鴉片類、鐵劑)、如廁習慣、旅行或作息改變

inquiry_en.why: Frequency and stool consistency (Bristol type) are case-layer quantities, but a rough sense is still needed to judge urgency
Fluid intake, fiber intake, activity level, medication (opioids, iron), toileting habits, travel or routine change
What food or method helps, and whether the patient relies on laxatives

Severe abdominal pain, vomiting, complete inability to pass gas, blood in stool, fever enter the red-flag pathway; bloating and belching suggest qi-type constipation, cold aversion and cold limbs suggest yang-deficiency cold constipation
Acute new-onset (especially with severe pain) and chronic habitual constipation are managed differently

differentiation_en.distinguishing: Stool hard like sheep pellets, distension worse for pressure, dry mouth, bad breath, red face, vexation, scanty dark urine

differentiation_en.variant: Urge without ability to pass stool, frequent belching, hypochondriac/lower-abdominal fullness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Has the urge but struggles to pass stool, tracks emotional state, frequent belching, hypochondriac or lower abdominal fullness

differentiation_en.variant: Stool not hard but difficult to expel, fatigue after defecation, shortness of breath
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Stool not actually hard, but straining is exhausting, sweating and breathlessness after the effort, general fatigue

differentiation_en.variant: Difficult stool passage, cold aversion and cold limbs, cold aching low back and knees
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Difficult to pass stool, clear copious urine, cold aversion and cold limbs, cold aching low back and knees, prefers warmth

red_flags_zh: 便秘合併劇烈腹脹腹痛、嘔吐、完全無法排氣 → 排除腸阻塞，急症轉診
便秘合併便血或黑便 → 需評估消化道出血或腫瘤
新發便秘合併不明原因體重下降，尤其中老年人 → 需進一步檢查排除腸道腫瘤
便秘合併發熱、劇烈腹痛拒按 → 排除急腹症
red_flags_en: Constipation with severe distension and pain, vomiting, complete inability to pass gas → rule out bowel obstruction, urgent referral
Constipation with blood in stool or black stool → needs evaluation for GI bleeding or malignancy
New constipation with unexplained weight loss, especially in an older patient → needs further workup to rule out bowel malignancy
Constipation with fever and severe pain worse for pressure → rule out acute abdomen

inquiry_zh.why: 食後即瀉、黎明前作瀉(五更瀉)、情緒波動後發作各指向不同證型
飲食(生冷、油膩、不潔)、情緒、旅行史、近期用藥(抗生素)、乳製品
瀉後腹痛是否緩解、禁食是否改善
血便或黑便、嚴重脫水、持續嘔吐、劇烈腹痛、高燒 —— 進紅旗流程；腸鳴腹痛瀉後痛減提示食滯

inquiry_en.why: Right after eating, before dawn (classic '5am diarrhea'), or after emotional upset each point toward a different pattern
Diet (raw/cold food, greasy food, contaminated food), emotion, travel history, recent antibiotic use, dairy
Whether the pain eases after passing stool, whether fasting improves it
Bloody or black stool, severe dehydration, persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, high fever enter the red-flag pathway; cramping that eases after passing stool suggests food stagnation
Acute (days, usually external contraction or food poisoning) versus chronic recurrent (weeks or more, needs workup for organic disease) are managed differently

differentiation_en.variant: Diarrhea from food stagnation, sour rotten stool, cramping relieved after passing stool
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Stool containing undigested food, sour and foul, distending abdominal pain relieved after passing stool, belching, loss of appetite

differentiation_en.variant: Loose stool, poor appetite and bloating, fatigue, recurrent
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Alternating loose stool and diarrhea, worse with any greasy food, poor appetite, bloating, fatigue, sallow complexion, drags on and recurs

differentiation_en.variant: Pre-dawn periumbilical pain, diarrhea with bowel sounds, relieved after passing stool, cold aversion and cold limbs
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Periumbilical pain before dawn, diarrhea with loud bowel sounds, pain eased after passing stool, cold aversion, cold limbs, cold aching low back and knees — the classic 'fifth-watch diarrhea'

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus — When to seek emergency care (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm)
red_flags_zh: 腹瀉合併血便或黑便 → 排除消化道出血
腹瀉合併嚴重脫水徵象(口乾、少尿、頭暈站不穩、皮膚彈性差) → 需醫療評估補液
腹瀉合併持續嘔吐無法進食進水、劇烈腹痛或高燒 → 需緊急評估

red_flags_en: Diarrhea with blood in stool or black stool → rule out GI bleeding
Diarrhea with signs of significant dehydration (dry mouth, reduced urination, dizziness on standing, poor skin turgor) → needs medical evaluation for rehydration
Diarrhea with persistent vomiting preventing oral intake, severe abdominal pain, or high fever → needs urgent evaluation
Diarrhea in infants or older adults with marked lethargy → needs earlier medical attention than in a typical adult
sources: MedlinePlus — When to seek emergency care (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm)

red_flags_zh: 食慾不振合併不明原因明顯體重下降 → 需進一步檢查排除惡性腫瘤或系統性疾病
食慾不振合併明顯脫水或無法進食進水 → 需醫療評估
食慾不振合併消化道出血徵象 → 需緊急評估
食慾不振合併嚴重憂鬱情緒或自殺意念 → 立即精神科評估／轉診
red_flags_en: Poor appetite with unexplained significant weight loss → needs further workup to rule out malignancy or systemic disease
Poor appetite with significant dehydration or inability to take food/fluids → needs medical evaluation
Poor appetite with signs of GI bleeding → needs urgent evaluation
Poor appetite with severe depression or suicidal ideation → immediate psychiatric evaluation/referral
sources: MedlinePlus — When to seek emergency care (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm)

records.definition_zh: 自覺肌肉力量下降，難以完成原本可勝任的動作，與疲勞(整體精力不足但肌力正常)不同 —— 兩者問診時需分辨，尤其單側突發無力是重要紅旗。
records.definition_en: A subjective loss of muscular strength, difficulty performing tasks previously manageable — distinct from fatigue (overall low energy with normal strength). This distinction matters most for sudden one-sided weakness, an important red flag.
records.patient_words_zh: 「手沒力氣拿東西」「腿軟」「爬樓梯腿沒力」「一邊手腳突然沒力」「握力變差，東西常常拿不穩」
records.patient_words_en: "My hand has no strength to hold things", "my legs feel wobbly", "my legs give out on stairs", "one side of my body suddenly feels weak", "my grip is weaker, I keep dropping things"

location.why: 已由 taxonomy_ids 定位於全身及四肢，無力本身無更細部位軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用於無力

laterality.diagnostic_note_zh: 單側突發無力是中風的核心紅旗；雙側對稱、漸進性無力多屬氣虛或脾腎兩虛，辨證意義完全不同

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 勞累後加重、休息可緩多屬氣虛；晨起明顯提示陽虛

inquiry_zh.why: 單側或雙側、上肢或下肢或全身，決定是否優先排除中風等急症
突發與漸進、勞累後加重的時間特徵指向完全不同的處置路徑
近期感染、勞累、飲食失調、藥物、慢性病史(糖尿病、甲狀腺疾病)
休息是否緩解 —— 休息可緩多屬虛，休息不緩甚至加重需考慮神經肌肉疾病
言語不清、臉部歪斜、視覺改變、吞嚥困難 —— 進紅旗流程；氣短懶言、腰膝痠軟提示證型方向
數分鐘至數小時內突發與數週至數月漸進，處置急迫性完全不同

inquiry_en.why: One-sided or bilateral, arm or leg or whole body — decides whether stroke must be ruled out first
Sudden versus gradual onset, and whether it worsens with exertion, point toward completely different management paths
Recent infection, exertion, poor diet, medication, chronic disease history (diabetes, thyroid disease)
Whether rest helps — improvement with rest suggests deficiency; no improvement or worsening with rest raises concern for neuromuscular disease
Slurred speech, facial droop, visual change, difficulty swallowing enter the red-flag pathway; shortness of breath and aching low back/knees point toward pattern differentiation
Sudden onset over minutes to hours versus gradual onset over weeks to months carries completely different urgency

differentiation_zh.variant: 肢體無力，氣短懶言，神疲自汗
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 四肢乏力，動則氣短，自汗，食少便溏，面色萎黃，脈弱

differentiation_zh.variant: 四肢痿軟無力，腰膝痠軟，耳鳴健忘
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肢體痿軟無力漸進發展，兼腰膝痠軟、耳鳴健忘、男子遺精，多見於久病或年長者

differentiation_zh.variant: 肢體困重無力，胸悶苔膩
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肢體無力兼沉重感，如物纏裹，胸悶脘痞，痰多，苔白膩

differentiation_zh.variant: 肢體無力，面色蒼白，頭暈心悸，唇甲淡白
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肢體無力兼氣血兩虛徵象——面色與唇甲淡白、頭暈心悸，月經量少色淡

differentiation_en.variant: Limb weakness with shortness of breath, fatigue and spontaneous sweating
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Weak limbs, breathless on exertion, spontaneous sweating, poor appetite, loose stool, sallow complexion, weak pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Flaccid limb weakness, weak aching low back and knees, tinnitus and forgetfulness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Gradually progressive flaccid weakness, with weak aching low back and knees, tinnitus, forgetfulness, seminal emission in men; usually chronic illness or older patients

differentiation_en.variant: Heavy weak limbs, chest fullness, greasy coating
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Weakness with a heavy wrapped sensation, chest and epigastric fullness, copious phlegm, white greasy coating

differentiation_en.variant: Limb weakness, pale complexion, dizziness and palpitations, pale lips and nails
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Limb weakness with signs of combined qi-blood deficiency — pale complexion, lips and nails, dizziness, palpitations, scanty pale menses

red_flags_zh: 突發單側肢體無力，合併臉部歪斜或言語不清 → 排除腦中風，立即送急診(記錄發作時間)
無力合併視覺改變、行走困難或步態不穩 → 需緊急神經學評估
急性進行性雙側肢體無力，尤其由下肢向上蔓延 → 排除格林-巴利症候群等神經急症
無力合併吞嚥困難或呼吸困難 → 需緊急評估
red_flags_en: Sudden one-sided limb weakness with facial droop or slurred speech → rule out stroke, send to emergency immediately (note the time of onset)
Weakness with visual change, difficulty walking or unsteady gait → needs urgent neurologic evaluation
Acute progressive bilateral limb weakness, especially ascending from the legs → rule out neurologic emergencies such as Guillain-Barré syndrome
Weakness with difficulty swallowing or breathing → needs urgent evaluation
sources: CDC — Stroke signs and symptoms (https://www.cdc.gov/stroke/signs-symptoms/index.html)

中醫內科學 痿證／虛勞篇 —— 脾氣虛・腎精不足・痰濕・氣血兩虛分證

field_sources.definition_zh/en: 一般臨床對 weakness(肌力下降)與 fatigue(整體精力不足)的區分 + 中醫痿證/虛勞篇
field_sources.differentiation_zh/en: 中醫內科學 痿證／虛勞分證 + 本 repo pattern_library 對應證型 key_signs_zh 對照

records.definition_zh: 膝關節內、周圍或牽連小腿、大腿的疼痛，可伴腫脹、活動受限或積液。是主訴而非診斷——同一個膝痛可以是退化性關節炎、韌帶或半月板損傷、痛風、類風濕性關節炎，也可以是中醫的痺症、筋傷。
records.definition_en: Pain in, around, or referred from the knee joint, sometimes with swelling, restricted motion, or effusion. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same knee pain can sit under osteoarthritis, ligament or meniscal injury, gout, rheumatoid arthritis, or the TCM Bi-syndrome and sinew injury categories.
records.patient_words_zh: 「上下樓梯特別痛」「蹲不下去」「膝蓋卡卡的」「腫得像饅頭」「走久了就沒力」「天氣變化前就先痛」
records.patient_words_en: "Stairs are the worst", "I can't squat down", "my knee catches/locks", "it's swollen like a bun", "my leg gives out after walking a while", "it aches before the weather changes"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 腫痛重著屬濕痺 · 刺痛拒按屬瘀 · 隱痛痠軟屬肝腎虧虛 · 灼痛紅腫屬熱痺

inquiry_zh.why: 膝內側、外側、髕骨前、膕窩各指向不同結構性病因
腫脹重著、刺痛固定、隱痛痠軟、紅腫灼熱分屬四類病機
外傷、久蹲久跪、負重運動、天氣濕冷、年齡退化
休息是否減輕、熱敷是否舒緩、活動後是否反而加重
腫脹積液、關節絞鎖、發熱紅腫、全身多關節受累提示不同方向
急性外傷與慢性反覆退化處置完全不同

inquiry_en.why: Medial, lateral, anterior/patellar, or popliteal each points to a different structural cause
Swollen and heavy, fixed stabbing, dull and achy, or hot and red map to four different mechanisms
Trauma, prolonged squatting or kneeling, load-bearing exercise, cold-damp weather, age-related degeneration
Whether rest helps, whether heat soothes it, or whether it paradoxically worsens with activity
Effusion, locking, fever with redness, or involvement of multiple joints each point a different way
An acute injury and a slow degenerative course are managed completely differently

differentiation_zh.variant: 腫脹重著，遇陰雨加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 膝部腫脹重著，屈伸不利，遇陰雨寒濕天氣加重，得溫稍舒

differentiation_zh.variant: 紅腫灼熱疼痛，拒按
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 關節紅腫灼熱，疼痛拒按，可伴發熱，多見於痛風急性發作或感染性關節炎

differentiation_zh.variant: 隱痛痠軟，勞累加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 膝部隱隱痠痛，勞則加重，休息減輕，兼腰膝痠軟、頭暈耳鳴，多見於退化性關節炎或久病老年

differentiation_zh.variant: 刺痛固定，外傷或久病史
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 痛處固定不移，拒按，夜間痛甚，多有外傷或關節損傷病史

differentiation_en.variant: Swollen and heavy, worse in damp weather
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Swollen, heavy knee with restricted flexion/extension, worse in cold-damp weather, slightly better for warmth

differentiation_en.variant: Hot, red, worse for pressure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Red, swollen, hot joint, tender to pressure, may have fever — typical of acute gout flare or septic/inflammatory arthritis

differentiation_en.variant: Dull aching, worse with exertion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vague chronic ache worse with exertion and better with rest, with weak aching low back and knees, dizziness and tinnitus — typical of degenerative joint disease or older patients

differentiation_en.variant: Fixed stabbing pain, injury history
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fixed unmoving pain, tender to pressure, worse at night, usually with a trauma or joint injury history

red_flags_zh: 關節紅腫熱痛合併發熱 → 排除化膿性關節炎，需緊急處置
重大外傷後無法負重、明顯畸形或神經血管徵象異常 → 需立即影像與骨科評估
膝部腫脹合併全身多關節受累、晨僵超過一小時 → 提示發炎性關節炎（如類風濕性關節炎），需轉診
red_flags_en: Hot, red, swollen joint with fever → rule out septic arthritis, urgent treatment needed
Inability to bear weight, visible deformity, or abnormal neurovascular signs after major trauma → immediate imaging and orthopedic assessment
Knee swelling with involvement of multiple other joints and morning stiffness over an hour → suggests inflammatory arthritis (e.g. rheumatoid arthritis), refer for assessment
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）
中醫傷科學／中醫內科學 痺症篇 —— 風寒濕痺、熱痺、肝腎虧虛型膝痛分證

field_sources.definition_zh/en: 骨科學對 knee pain 範圍界定 + 中醫傷科對膝痛的一般描述
field_sources.differentiation_zh/en: 中醫內科學／傷科學 痺症分證 + 本 repo pattern_library 對應證型 key_signs_zh 對照
field_sources.supporting_measurements: data/clinical_cases/outcome_metrics.json — metric.pain_score（既有，未新增；沿用 sym.headache/neck_pain/shoulder_pain/low_back_pain 先例）

records.definition_zh: 肌肉突然不自主、強烈收縮，多見於小腿腓腸肌，常在夜間或運動後發作，可觸及硬塊，數秒至數分鐘後緩解。與持續性肌張力異常（如痙攣、僵直）不同——抽筋是陣發性的。
records.definition_en: A sudden, involuntary, strongly painful muscle contraction, most often in the calf, commonly at night or after exercise, palpable as a hard knot, resolving over seconds to minutes. Distinct from sustained tone abnormalities such as spasticity or rigidity — a cramp is paroxysmal.
records.patient_words_zh: 「半夜小腿突然抽起來，痛到跳起來」「肌肉整個縮成一塊，硬邦邦的」「運動完就開始抽」「一抽筋要按摩很久才鬆開」
records.patient_words_en: "My calf seizes up in the middle of the night and I jump out of bed", "the muscle balls up hard", "it starts right after I exercise", "it takes ages of rubbing before it lets go"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 冷痛拘急屬寒凝 · 抽掣痠軟屬血虛不榮筋 · 掣痛兼煩熱屬陰虛

inquiry_zh.why: 小腿腓腸肌最常見；足底、大腿、手部抽筋指向不同誘因
夜間發作多屬血虛、腎虛；運動後即發多屬津液耗傷
運動出汗、懷孕、久站、脫水、利尿劑或某些藥物、寒冷刺激
按摩伸展是否可解、熱敷是否有效
肢冷畏寒、口乾煩熱、肌肉無力持續、單側腫脹疼痛提示不同方向
偶發與頻繁反覆的處置與檢查方向不同

inquiry_en.why: The calf is most common; foot, thigh, or hand cramps point to different triggers
Nocturnal cramps often signal blood or Kidney deficiency; cramps right after exercise suggest fluid loss
Exercise and sweating, pregnancy, prolonged standing, dehydration, diuretics or certain medications, cold exposure
Whether massage or stretching resolves it, whether heat helps
Cold limbs and cold aversion, dry mouth with vexing heat, persistent muscle weakness, or one-sided swelling and pain each point a different way
Occasional versus frequent recurrent cramping changes both workup and management

differentiation_zh.variant: 冷痛拘急，畏寒肢冷
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 抽筋遇寒加重，得溫則緩，兼畏寒肢冷、腰膝痠冷

differentiation_zh.variant: 夜間抽筋，爪甲不榮，面色淡白
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 夜間或休息時抽筋，兼頭暈眼花、爪甲不榮、面色淡白，屬血虛不能榮養筋脈

differentiation_zh.variant: 抽筋伴口乾咽燥，運動後汗出多
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 運動或出汗後抽筋，兼口乾咽燥、五心煩熱，屬陰虛津傷、筋脈失濡

differentiation_en.variant: Cold, gripping pain with cold aversion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Cramp worse in cold, better for warmth, with cold aversion and cold aching low back and knees

differentiation_en.variant: Nocturnal cramping, poor nails, pale complexion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Cramps at night or at rest, with dizziness, blurred vision, poorly nourished nails and a pale complexion — Blood too deficient to nourish the sinews

differentiation_en.variant: Cramping with dry mouth, heavy sweating after exercise
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Cramps after exercise or sweating, with dry mouth and throat and vexing heat in the five centers — Yin and fluids depleted, sinews under-nourished

red_flags_zh: 抽筋部位明顯單側腫脹、皮溫升高、壓痛 → 排除深層靜脈栓塞
抽筋伴進行性肌肉無力、運動後茶色尿 → 排除橫紋肌溶解症，需緊急就醫
抽筋伴單側肢體無力、言語或視覺改變 → 排除中風
red_flags_en: Marked one-sided swelling, warmth, and tenderness at the cramp site → rule out deep vein thrombosis
Cramping with progressive muscle weakness and tea-colored urine after exertion → rule out rhabdomyolysis, urgent care needed
Cramping with one-sided limb weakness, speech, or vision change → rule out stroke
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）；CDC stroke signs and symptoms
中醫內科學 —— 轉筋／筋惕肉瞤 相關證型：血虛、腎陽虛、陰虛
本 repo 既有卡片：pattern_library 各證型 key_signs_zh

field_sources.definition_zh/en: 一般臨床對 muscle cramp 的定義（陣發性不自主強直收縮）+ 中醫「轉筋」描述
field_sources.differentiation_zh/en: 中醫內科學 轉筋／痙證相關證型 + 本 repo pattern_library 對應證型 key_signs_zh 對照
field_sources.supporting_measurements: 刻意留空 —— 目前 26 個 outcome metrics 無對應肌肉抽筋頻率／強度量化項

records.definition_zh: 自覺呼吸費力、喘不過氣或需要更用力才能吸到足夠空氣的主觀感受，可在靜止或活動時出現。是主訴而非診斷——同一個氣短可以是心臟、肺臟、貧血、焦慮或中醫的肺脾腎氣虛、痰飲。
records.definition_en: The subjective sense of effortful breathing, air hunger, or needing to work harder to get enough air, at rest or on exertion. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same breathlessness can sit under cardiac, pulmonary, anemic, or anxiety-related causes, or the TCM categories of Lung/Spleen/Kidney Qi deficiency and phlegm-rheum.
records.patient_words_zh: 「爬個樓梯就喘」「胸口悶悶的吸不飽」「講話講到一半要換氣」「躺平就喘不過氣」「一動就上氣不接下氣」
records.patient_words_en: "A flight of stairs and I'm gasping", "my chest feels tight, I can't get a full breath", "I have to stop mid-sentence to breathe", "I can't breathe lying flat", "the moment I move I'm out of breath"

location.why: 全身性呼吸症狀，無部位辨證軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 動則氣短屬氣虛 · 夜間平臥加重提示心衰竭需紅旗評估

inquiry_zh.why: 活動後、靜止時、平躺後各指向不同機轉——心因性常平躺加重，氣虛則動輒喘
夜間陣發性呼吸困難是心衰竭的關鍵警訊；晨起明顯提示肺氣虛
坐起是否緩解、休息是否恢復、用藥（吸入劑）反應
胸痛、心悸、下肢腫、咳痰、發熱、體重變化——紅旗多掛在這一問上
急性驟發與慢性漸進的鑑別方向與急迫程度完全不同

inquiry_en.why: With exertion, at rest, or lying flat each points to a different mechanism — cardiac causes often worsen lying flat, Qi deficiency worsens with any exertion
Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea is a key warning sign for heart failure; prominent on waking suggests Lung Qi deficiency
Whether sitting up helps, whether rest restores normal breathing, response to inhaler medication
Chest pain, palpitations, leg swelling, cough with sputum, fever, weight change — most red flags hang off this question
Sudden acute onset versus slow chronic progression differ completely in both differential and urgency

differentiation_zh.variant: 動則氣短，自汗易感
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 稍動即氣短，語聲低怯，自汗，易感冒，兼倦怠乏力

differentiation_zh.variant: 喘促痰多黏稠色黃
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 喘促胸悶，咳痰黃稠量多，兼身熱口渴

differentiation_zh.variant: 呼多吸少，動則喘甚，腰膝痠軟
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 呼氣多吸氣少，動則喘息尤甚，兼腰膝痠軟、畏寒肢冷，屬腎不納氣

differentiation_zh.variant: 胸悶氣短，痰多苔膩
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 胸悶氣短，咳痰量多色白易咯，兼身重納呆

differentiation_en.variant: Breathless on exertion, spontaneous sweating, easily catches colds
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Breathless with the least exertion, weak low voice, spontaneous sweating, catches colds easily, with fatigue

differentiation_en.variant: Wheezy breathlessness with thick yellow sputum
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Breathless with chest fullness, copious thick yellow sputum, with body heat and thirst

differentiation_en.variant: More breathing out than in, worse with exertion, weak aching low back and knees
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Difficulty inhaling relative to exhaling, markedly worse with exertion, with weak aching low back and knees and cold aversion — Kidney failing to grasp Qi

differentiation_en.variant: Chest fullness and breathlessness, copious sputum, greasy coating
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Chest fullness and breathlessness, copious white sputum that comes up easily, with heavy limbs and poor appetite

red_flags_zh: 突發或嚴重呼吸困難、發紺、無法平躺或講不出完整句子 → 屬急診等級
呼吸困難合併胸痛、意識改變 → 立即就醫評估
夜間陣發性呼吸困難、端坐呼吸、下肢腫 → 排除心衰竭
red_flags_en: Sudden or severe breathing difficulty, cyanosis, inability to lie flat, or inability to speak in full sentences → emergency-level
Breathing difficulty with chest pain or altered mental status → immediate medical evaluation
Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, orthopnea, and leg swelling → rule out heart failure
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）
