records.definition_zh: 因腦部血流突然減少導致的短暫意識喪失，通常自行且完全恢復。與眩暈（天旋地轉感，意識清楚）不同——暈厥是意識本身喪失。西醫需分辨反射性（血管迷走神經性）、姿勢性低血壓、心因性等病因，心因性暈厥風險最高。
records.definition_en: A transient loss of consciousness caused by a sudden reduction in cerebral blood flow, typically self-resolving with full recovery. Distinct from vertigo (a spinning sensation with consciousness intact) — syncope is loss of consciousness itself. Biomedically requires differentiating reflex (vasovagal), orthostatic, and cardiac causes; cardiac syncope carries the highest risk.
records.patient_words_zh: 「突然眼前一黑就昏過去了」「站著站著就暈倒了」「醒來發現自己躺在地上，不知道發生什麼事」
records.patient_words_en: "Everything went black and I passed out", "I was standing and just blacked out", "I woke up on the floor without knowing what happened"

location.why: 全身性意識狀態改變，非特定部位症狀

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 站立時或站立後誘發、久站悶熱環境誘發，多屬血管迷走神經性/姿勢性；運動中或運動後發作需高度懷疑心因性

inquiry_zh.why: 久站、悶熱、情緒緊張、抽血、疼痛刺激——血管迷走神經性方向；運動中或運動後發作——心因性方向，風險最高
發作前是否有心悸、胸痛、氣促的預兆，或完全無預兆突然倒下——無預兆者風險較高
家族中是否有年輕猝死病史；發作時是否合併抽搐、大小便失禁（需與癲癇鑑別）

inquiry_en.why: Prolonged standing, heat, emotional stress, blood draw, pain stimulus — vasovagal direction; occurring during or right after exercise — cardiac direction, highest risk
Whether palpitations, chest pain, or breathlessness preceded the episode, or whether it was entirely without warning — no-warning syncope carries higher risk
Family history of sudden death at a young age; whether the episode included convulsions or incontinence (differentiate from seizure)

differentiation_zh.variant: 暈厥前突發心悸、胸悶氣短，面色蒼白，冷汗
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 暈厥兼心悸氣短、面色蒼白，心氣不足，不能上榮清竅

differentiation_zh.variant: 暈厥前眩暈頭脹，面赤，情緒激動誘發
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 暈厥兼眩暈頭脹、面赤，肝陽上亢，氣血逆亂上衝

differentiation_en.variant: Sudden palpitations, chest tightness, and shortness of breath before syncope, with pallor and cold sweating
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Syncope with palpitations and pallor — Heart Qi insufficiency failing to nourish the clear orifices

differentiation_en.variant: Dizziness and head distension before syncope, facial flushing, triggered by emotional agitation
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Syncope with dizziness and facial flushing — Liver Yang rising with Qi and Blood surging upward

red_flags_zh: 暈厥發生於運動中或運動後 → 需緊急心臟評估排除致命性心律不整或結構性心臟病
暈厥合併胸痛、心悸、氣促 → 需緊急評估心因性暈厥
暈厥毫無預兆突然倒下（尤其合併外傷）或反覆發作 → 需醫療評估
暈厥合併家族年輕猝死病史 → 需心臟科評估
暈厥合併抽搐、舌咬傷、大小便失禁或發作後意識混亂延長 → 需神經科評估排除癲癇
red_flags_en: Syncope occurring during or immediately after exercise → urgent cardiac evaluation to rule out life-threatening arrhythmia or structural heart disease
Syncope with chest pain, palpitations, breathlessness → urgent evaluation for cardiac syncope
Syncope with no warning at all (especially with injury from the fall) or recurrent episodes → medical evaluation needed
Syncope with a family history of sudden death at a young age → cardiology evaluation
Syncope with convulsions, tongue biting, incontinence, or prolonged post-episode confusion → neurology evaluation to rule out seizure
sources: MedlinePlus: Fainting（https://medlineplus.gov/fainting.html）
MedlinePlus: Ventricular tachycardia（https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000187.htm）
MedlinePlus: Sick sinus syndrome（https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000161.htm）
中醫內科學 暈厥/厥證篇

field_sources.definition_zh/en: MedlinePlus fainting.html 定義 + 中醫內科學 厥證一般描述，明確與眩暈區分
field_sources.differentiation_zh/en: 中醫內科學 心氣不足、肝陽上亢厥證分證
field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: 運動中發作、心因性警訊、猝死家族史、癲癇鑑別為一般臨床急診常識，並列 MedlinePlus ventricular-tachycardia/sick-sinus-syndrome 條目佐證心因性暈厥風險

records.definition_zh: 咳嗽時咳出血液或帶血痰液，來源於下呼吸道。西醫將咳血列為需立即就醫評估的症狀之一，需與口鼻咽喉出血或嘔血鑑別來源；中醫則按血色鮮紅或暗紅、量多量少辨其寒熱虛實。
records.definition_en: Coughing up blood or blood-streaked sputum originating from the lower respiratory tract. Biomedically listed among the symptoms warranting immediate medical evaluation, and must be distinguished from bleeding originating in the nose/mouth/throat or from hematemesis (vomited blood); TCM differentiates by the color (bright versus dark red) and volume of blood.
records.patient_words_zh: 「咳出來的痰裡有血」「咳嗽咳到吐血」「痰是紅色或粉紅色的」
records.patient_words_en: "There's blood in what I cough up", "I coughed and blood came out", "My sputum is red or pink-tinged"

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用；本症性質軸是血色與血量，非疼痛性質

laterality.why: 呼吸道出血症狀，通常無法由患者自行定側

inquiry_zh.why: 發熱、夜間盜汗、體重下降、慢性咳嗽——結核病線索；胸痛、急性呼吸困難、單側下肢腫脹——肺栓塞線索
血色鮮紅泡沫狀（多來自肺）或暗紅混雜食物殘渣（需鑑別是否為嘔血）；出血量——痰中帶血絲或大量咳血
近期胸腔手術/創傷、抗凝血劑使用史、慢性肺病（支氣管擴張、肺癌）病史

inquiry_en.why: Fever, night sweats, weight loss, chronic cough — tuberculosis clues; chest pain, acute dyspnea, unilateral leg swelling — pulmonary embolism clues
Bright red frothy blood (usually pulmonary) versus dark blood mixed with food particles (differentiate from vomited blood); volume — blood-streaked sputum versus massive hemoptysis
Recent thoracic surgery/trauma, anticoagulant use, chronic lung disease history (bronchiectasis, lung cancer)

differentiation_zh.variant: 咳血鮮紅，量少，兼乾咳少痰、潮熱盜汗
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咳血兼陰虛徵象，虛火灼傷肺絡

differentiation_zh.variant: 咳血鮮紅，兼咳嗽陣作、胸脅疼痛、急躁易怒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咳血兼情緒誘發、脅痛，肝火犯肺，灼傷肺絡

differentiation_en.variant: Bright red hemoptysis, small volume, with dry cough and scant sputum, tidal heat and night sweats
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Hemoptysis with Yin-deficiency signs — deficiency fire scorching the Lung vessels

differentiation_en.variant: Bright red hemoptysis with paroxysmal coughing, rib-side pain, irritability
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Hemoptysis with emotional triggers and rib-side pain — Liver Fire invading and scorching the Lung

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus: When to use the emergency room - adult (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm)
red_flags_zh: 任何咳血或咳出帶血物質 → MedlinePlus 明確列為需立即至急診或撥打緊急電話評估的症狀
咳血合併大量出血（無法計量、持續不止） → 為呼吸道急症，需立即就醫
咳血合併發熱、夜間盜汗、體重下降、慢性咳嗽 → 需醫療評估排除肺結核
咳血合併胸痛、急性呼吸困難、心跳過快、單側下肢腫脹 → 需緊急評估肺栓塞
red_flags_en: Any coughing up of blood or blood-tinged material → MedlinePlus explicitly lists this as a symptom requiring immediate emergency department or emergency call evaluation
Hemoptysis with a large, uncontrolled volume of blood → a respiratory emergency requiring immediate care
Hemoptysis with fever, night sweats, weight loss, chronic cough → medical evaluation to rule out active tuberculosis
Hemoptysis with chest pain, acute dyspnea, tachycardia, unilateral leg swelling → urgent evaluation for pulmonary embolism
sources: MedlinePlus: When to use the emergency room - adult（https://medlineplus.gov/ency/patientinstructions/000593.htm）
CDC: About Venous Thromboembolism (Blood Clots)（https://www.cdc.gov/blood-clots/about/index.html）
MedlinePlus: Tuberculosis（https://medlineplus.gov/tuberculosis.html）

records.pinyin: dan ce xia zhi zhong zhang
records.pinyin_toned: dān cè xià zhī zhǒng zhàng
records.definition_zh: 僅單側下肢明顯腫脹，與 sym.edema（多為雙側、系統性水腫，見於心/腎/肝病）是不同的觀察點——單側急性腫脹的首要鑑別是深層靜脈栓塞（DVT），處置急迫性遠高於一般水腫。與蜂窩性組織炎、淋巴水腫、貝克氏囊腫破裂等亦需鑑別。
records.definition_en: Swelling clearly confined to one leg — a different observation point from sym.edema (usually bilateral, systemic swelling seen in heart/kidney/liver disease). The top differential for acute unilateral swelling is deep vein thrombosis (DVT), which carries far greater urgency than ordinary edema. Cellulitis, lymphedema, and a ruptured Baker cyst are also on the differential.
records.patient_words_zh: 「只有一隻腳腫起來」「這隻腿突然比另一隻粗很多」「小腿一邊腫一邊沒事」
records.patient_words_en: "Only one leg is swollen", "This leg suddenly got much bigger than the other", "One calf is swollen and the other is fine"

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用；本症核心是腫脹分布，非疼痛性質

laterality.diagnostic_note_zh: 單側是本症定義的核心，若轉為雙側對稱，應改記錄為 sym.edema

inquiry_zh.why: 近期長途飛行/久坐久站、近期手術、外傷、癌症病史、口服避孕藥或荷爾蒙治療、家族血栓病史——DVT 危險因子
紅、腫、熱、痛（局部四大特徵）——DVT 或蜂窩性組織炎的核心線索；發熱——感染方向
胸痛、急性呼吸困難、心跳加速 → 需警覺栓子已脫落至肺（肺栓塞）

inquiry_en.why: Recent long-haul travel/prolonged sitting or standing, recent surgery, trauma, cancer history, oral contraceptives or hormone therapy, family history of blood clots — DVT risk factors
Redness, warmth, swelling, pain (the local cardinal signs) — core clues for DVT or cellulitis; fever — infection direction
Chest pain, acute dyspnea, tachycardia → raise concern that a clot has embolized to the lungs (pulmonary embolism)

differentiation_zh.variant: 單側下肢腫脹沉重，痠痛，久站久坐後加重，得抬高緩解
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腫脹兼沉重乏力，久站加重，脾虛水濕下注（需先排除 DVT 才考慮此證）

differentiation_zh.variant: 單側下肢腫脹刺痛，皮色暗紅或紫暗，拒按
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腫脹兼刺痛拒按、皮色紫暗，血瘀阻滯脈絡（需先排除 DVT 才考慮此證）

differentiation_en.variant: Unilateral leg swelling with heaviness and aching, worse after prolonged standing/sitting, eased by elevation
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Swelling with heaviness and fatigue, worse with standing — Spleen deficiency with Damp pouring downward (DVT must be excluded before attributing to this pattern)

differentiation_en.variant: Unilateral leg swelling with stabbing pain, dusky-purple or reddish skin, resists pressure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Swelling with stabbing pain and discoloration — Blood stasis obstructing the channels (DVT must be excluded before attributing to this pattern)

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus: Foot, leg, and ankle swelling (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003104.htm)
red_flags_zh: 單側下肢新發或加劇腫脹，合併紅、熱、壓痛 → 需立即就醫排除深層靜脈栓塞（DVT）
單側下肢腫脹合併胸痛或呼吸困難 → 需撥打緊急電話，可能為肺栓塞
單側下肢腫脹合併發燒 → 需醫療評估排除蜂窩性組織炎等感染
妊娠期間單側下肢突然腫脹加劇 → 需醫療評估
已知心、腎、肝病史者出現單側下肢腫脹加劇 → 需醫療評估
red_flags_en: New or worsening unilateral leg swelling with redness, warmth, tenderness → seek care immediately to rule out deep vein thrombosis (DVT)
Unilateral leg swelling with chest pain or shortness of breath → call emergency services, possible pulmonary embolism
Unilateral leg swelling with fever → medical evaluation to rule out cellulitis or another infection
Sudden worsening of unilateral leg swelling during pregnancy → medical evaluation needed
Worsening unilateral leg swelling in someone with known heart, kidney, or liver disease → medical evaluation needed
sources: MedlinePlus: Foot, leg, and ankle swelling（https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003104.htm）
CDC: About Venous Thromboembolism (Blood Clots)（https://www.cdc.gov/blood-clots/about/index.html）

field_sources.definition_zh/en: MedlinePlus leg-swelling 條目（明確列出單側新發腫脹為紅旗）+ CDC DVT 條目 + 中醫內科學 水腫一般描述，並與既有 sym.edema 明確區分適用範圍
field_sources.differentiation_zh/en: 中醫內科學 脾虛水濕、血瘀水腫分證，並標註須先排除 DVT
field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: MedlinePlus article 003104（單側腫脹紅旗）+ CDC blood-clots 條目逐條引用擴寫

aliases_en: Exertional leg cramping relieved by rest
records.definition_zh: 行走或爬樓梯一段固定距離後，小腿（或臀部、大腿）出現痠痛、抽筋或無力感，休息數分鐘後緩解，再走同樣距離又復發。是周邊動脈疾病（PAD）的典型症狀，由動脈粥狀硬化造成的血流不足所致。突發劇痛合併肢體冰冷蒼白無脈是血管急症，與慢性間歇性跛行需嚴格區分。
records.definition_en: Aching, cramping, or weakness in the calf (or buttock/thigh) that appears after walking or climbing stairs a consistent distance, resolves with a few minutes of rest, and recurs after walking the same distance again. The classic symptom of peripheral arterial disease (PAD), caused by atherosclerotic narrowing of blood flow. Sudden severe pain with a cold, pale, pulseless limb is a vascular emergency and must be strictly distinguished from chronic intermittent claudication.
records.patient_words_zh: 「走一段路小腿就痠痛，要停下來休息才能繼續走」「爬樓梯爬到一半腿就沒力」「休息一下痛就消了，再走又開始」
records.patient_words_en: "My calf starts aching after walking a certain distance and I have to stop", "My leg gives out partway up the stairs", "The pain goes away with rest but comes back when I walk again"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 痠痛乏力多屬氣虛/脈絡失養；冷痛遇寒加重多屬寒凝血瘀

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 與行走距離固定相關、休息可緩解，是間歇性跛行區別於其他腿痛的核心時間型態

inquiry_zh.why: 行走固定距離後誘發、休息緩解——PAD 典型型態；是否有糖尿病、吸煙、高血壓病史——PAD 危險因子
足部/小腿傷口癒合不良、皮膚顏色改變、毛髮脫落——慢性缺血徵象；靜息時仍痛——病情已進展
是否為突發劇痛合併肢體冰冷蒼白——需與慢性間歇性跛行嚴格區分，前者為血管急症

inquiry_en.why: Provoked after a consistent walking distance, relieved by rest — the classic PAD pattern; diabetes, smoking, hypertension history — PAD risk factors
Poorly healing foot/leg wounds, skin color change, hair loss — signs of chronic ischemia; pain persisting at rest — disease progression
Whether onset was sudden and severe with a cold, pale limb — must be strictly distinguished from chronic intermittent claudication, as the former is a vascular emergency

differentiation_zh.variant: 步行後小腿痠痛乏力，休息緩解，兼神疲氣短
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 跛行兼全身氣虛徵象，氣虛不能榮養脈絡

differentiation_zh.variant: 步行後小腿冷痛，遇寒加重，膚色蒼白或紫暗
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 跛行兼冷痛、膚色紫暗，寒凝血瘀，脈絡阻滯

differentiation_en.variant: Calf aching and weakness after walking, relieved by rest, with fatigue and shortness of breath
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Claudication with generalized Qi-deficiency signs — Qi insufficient to nourish the channels

differentiation_en.variant: Cold calf pain after walking, worse with cold, pale or dusky-purple skin
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Claudication with cold pain and discoloration — Cold congealing the Blood, obstructing the channels

red_flags_zh: 突發劇烈肢體疼痛合併肢體冰冷、蒼白、脈搏消失或麻木無力 → 需緊急就醫排除急性肢體缺血，屬血管外科急症
跛行進展為靜息時仍持續疼痛，或足部/腳趾出現癒合不良的傷口、發黑 → 需醫療評估，可能已進展至嚴重周邊動脈疾病
跛行合併已知糖尿病、吸煙史，或合併心臟病/腦中風病史 → 需醫療評估整體心血管風險
red_flags_en: Sudden severe limb pain with a cold, pale limb, absent pulse, or numbness/weakness → seek care immediately to rule out acute limb ischemia, a vascular surgical emergency
Claudication progressing to pain persisting at rest, or poorly healing/blackened wounds on the foot or toes → medical evaluation needed, possible progression to severe peripheral arterial disease
Claudication in someone with known diabetes, smoking history, or a history of heart disease/stroke → medical evaluation of overall cardiovascular risk
sources: MedlinePlus: Peripheral Arterial Disease | PAD（https://medlineplus.gov/peripheralarterialdisease.html）
MedlinePlus: Leg pain（https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003182.htm）
